Kal-hannetinim uvne avde shelomo shelosh meot tishim ushnayim
Veelle haolim mittel melach tel charsha keruv addan immer velo yachlu lehaggid bet-avotam vezaram im miyyisrael hem
Bene-delaya vene-toviyya bene nekoda shesh meot chamishshim ushnayim
Umibbene hakkohanim bene chovayya bene hakkotz bene varzillay asher lakach mibbenot barzillay haggiladi ishsha vayyikkare al-shemam
Elle bikshu chetavam hammityachsim velo nimtzau vayegoalu min-hakkehunna
Vayyomer hattirshata lahem asher lo-yochlu mikkodesh hakkodashim ad amod kohen leurim ultummim
Kal-hakkahal keechad arba ribbo alpayim shelosh-meot shishshim
Millevad avdehem veamhotehem elle shivat alafim shelosh meot sheloshim veshiva velahem meshorrim umshorrot matayim
Susehem sheva meot sheloshim veshishsha pirdehem matayim arbaim vachamishsha
Gemallehem arba meot sheloshim vachamishsha chamorim sheshet alafim sheva meot veesrim
Umerashe haavot bevoam levet Adonai asher birushalam hitnaddevu levet haelohim lehaamido al-mechono
Kechocham natnu leotzar hammelacha zahav darkemonim shesh-ribbot vaelef s vechesef manim chameshet alafim vechatnot kohanim mea
Vayyeshvu hakkohanim vehalviyyim umin-haam vehamshorrim vehashshoarim vehannetinim bearehem vechal-yisrael bearehem
Vayyigga hachodesh hashshevii uvne yisrael bearim s vayyeasfu haam keish echad el-yerushalam
Vayyakam yeshua ben-yotzadak veechav hakkohanim uzrubbavel ben-shealtiel veechav vayyivnu et-mizbach elohe yisrael lehaalot alav olot kakkatuv betorat moshe ish-haelohim
Vayyachinu hammizbeach al-mechonotav ki beema alehem meamme haaratzot vayyaalu alav olot la-Adonai olot labboker velaarev
Vayyaasu et-chag hassukkot kakkatuv veolat yom beom bemispar kemishpat devar-yom beomo
Veacharechen olat tamid velechodashim ulchal-moade Adonai hamkuddashim ulchol mitnaddev nedava la-Adonai
Miyyom echad lachodesh hashshevii hechellu lehaalot olot la-Adonai vehechal Adonai lo yussad
Vayyittenu-chesef lachotzvim velecharashim umaachal umishte vashemen latztzidonim velatztzorim lehavi atze arazim min-hallevanon el-yam yafo kerishon koresh melech-paras alehem

Uvashshana hashshenit levoam el-bet haelohim lirushalam bachodesh hashsheni hechellu zerubbavel ben-shealtiel veyeshua ben-yotzadak ushar achehem hakkohanim vehalviyyim vechal-habbaim mehashshevi yerushalam vayyaamidu et-halviyyim mibben esrim shana vamala lenatztzeach al-melechet bet-Adonai
Vayyaamod yeshua banav veechav kadmiel uvanav bene-yehuda keechad lenatztzeach al-ose hammelacha bevet haelohim s bene chenadad benehem vaachehem halviyyim
Veyissedu habbonim et-hechal Adonai vayyaamidu hakkohanim melubbashim bachatzotzrot vehalviyyim bene-asaf bamtziltayim lehallel et-Adonai al-yede david melech-yisrael
Vayyaanu behallel uvhodot la-Adonai ki tov ki-leolam chasdo al-yisrael vechal-haam heriu terua gedola vehallel la-Adonai al husad bet-Adonai
Verabbim mehakkohanim vehalviyyim verashe haavot hazzekenim asher rau et-habbayit harishon beyasdo ze habbayit beenehem bochim bekol gadol verabbim bitrua vesimcha leharim kol
Veen haam makkirim kol teruat hassimcha lekol bechi haam ki haam meriim terua gedola vehakkol nishma ad-lemerachok
Vayyishmeu tzare yehuda uvinyamin ki-vene haggola bonim hechal la-Adonai elohe yisrael
Vayyiggeshu el-zerubbavel veel-rashe haavot vayyomru lahem nivne immachem ki chachem nidrosh lelohechem velo anachnu zovchim mime esar chaddon melech ashshur hammaale otanu po
Vayyomer lahem zerubbavel veyeshua ushar rashe haavot leyisrael lo-lachem valanu livnot bayit lelohenu ki anachnu yachad nivne la-Adonai elohe yisrael kaasher tzivanu hammelech koresh melech-paras
Vayehi am-haaretz merappim yede am-yehuda umvahalim otam livnot
Vesochrim alehem yoatzim lehafer atzatam kal-yeme koresh melech paras vead-malchut daryavesh melech-paras
Uvmalchut achashverosh bitchillat malchuto katvu sitna al-yoshve yehuda virushalam
Uvime artachshasta katav bishlam mitredat tavel ushar kenaotav artachshaste melech paras uchtav hannishtevan katuv aramit umturgam aramit
Rechum beel-teem veshimshay safra ketavu iggera chada al-yerushlem leartachshaste malka kenema
Edayin rechum beel-teem veshimshay safra ushar kenavathon dinaye vaafarsatchaye tarpelaye afarsaye arkevaye vavlaye shushanchaye dehaye elmaye
Ushar ummayya di hagli asnappar rabba veyakkira vehotev himmo bekirya di shamrayin ushar avar-nahara uchenet
Dena parshegen iggarta di shelachu alohi al-artachshaste malka avdach enash avar-nahara uchenet
Yedia leheve lemalka di yehudaye di seliku min-levatach alena ato lirushlem kiryeta maradta uvishta banayin veshurayya shachlilu veushshayya yachitu
Kean yedia leheve lemalka di hen kiryeta dach titbene veshurayya yishtachlelun minda-velo vahalach la yintenun veappetom malchim tehanzik
Kean kal-kovel di-melach hechla melachna vearvat malka la arich lana lemecheze al-dena shelachna vehodana lemalka

Di yevakkar bisfar-dachranayya di avahatach uthashkach bisfar dachranayya vetinda di kiryeta dach kirya marada umhanzekat malchin umdinan veeshtaddur avdin begavah min-yomat alma al-dena kiryeta dach hacharvat
Mehodin anachna lemalka di hen kiryeta dach titbene veshurayya yishtachlelun lakovel dena chalak baavar nahara la itay lach
Pitgama shelach malka al-rechum beel-teem veshimshay safra ushar kenavathon di yatvin beshamrayin ushar avar-nahara shelam uchet
Nishtevana di shelachtun alena mefarash keri kadamay
Uminni sim teem uvakkaru vehashkachu di kiryeta dach min-yomat alma al-malchin mitnassea umrad veeshtaddur mitaved-bah
Umalchin takkifin hao al-yerushlem veshallitin bechol avar nahara umidda velo vahalach mityehev lehon
Kean simu teem levattala guvrayya illech vekiryeta dach la titbene ad-minni tama yittesam
Uzhirin heo shalu lemebad al-dena lema yisge chavala lehanzakat malchin
Edayin min-di parshegen nishtevana di artachshaste malka keri kodam-rechum veshimshay safra uchnavathon azalu vivhilu lirushlem al-yehudaye uvattilu himmo beedra vechayil
Bedayin betelat avidat bet-elaha di birushlem vahavat batla ad shenat tarten lemalchut daryavesh melech-paras
Vehitnabbi chaggay neviyya uzcharya var-iddo neviyyayya al-yehudaye di vihud uvirushlem beshum elah yisrael alehon
Bedayin kamu zerubbavel bar-shealtiel veyeshua bar-yotzadak veshariv lemivne bet elaha di virushlem veimmehon neviyyayya di-elaha mesaadin lehon
Beh-zimna ata alehon tattenay pachat avar-nahara ushtar boznay uchnavathon vechen amrin lehom man-sam lechom teem bayeta dena libbene veushsharna dena leshachlala
Edayin kenema amarna lehom man-innun shemahat guvrayya di-dena vinyana banayin
Veen elahahom havat al-save yehudaye vela-vattilu himmo ad-tama ledaryavesh yehach veedayin yetivun nishtevana al-dena
Parshegen iggarta di-shelach tattenay pachat avar-nahara ushtar boznay uchnavateh afarsechaye di baavar nahara al-daryavesh malka
Pitgama shelachu alohi vechidna ketiv begaveh ledaryavesh malka shelama cholla
Yedia leheve lemalka di-azalna lihud medinta levet elaha rabba vehu mitbene even gelal vea mittesam bechutlayya vaavidta dach asparna mitavda umatzlach beyedhom
Edayin sheelna lesavayya illech kenema amarna lehom man-sam lechom teem bayeta dena lemivneya veushsharna dena leshachlala
Veaf shemahathom sheelna lehom lehodautach di nichtuv shum-guvrayya di verashehom
Uchnema fitgama hativuna lememar anachna himmo avdohi di-elah shemayya veara uvanayin bayeta di-hava vene mikkadmat dena shenin saggian umelech leyisrael rav benahi veshachleleh
Lahen min-di hargizu avahotana leelah shemayya yehav himmo beyad nevuchadnetztzar melech-bavel kasdaa uvayeta dena satreh veamma hagli levavel
Beram bishnat chada lechoresh malka di vavel koresh malka sam teem bet-elaha dena libbene

Veaf manayya di-vet-elaha di dahava vechaspa di nevuchadnetztzar hanpek min-hechla di virushlem vehevel himmo lehechla di vavel hanpek himmo koresh malka min-hechla di vavel vihivu lesheshbatztzar shemeh di fecha sameh
Vaamar-leh el manayya se ezel-achet himmo behechla di virushlem uvet elaha yitbene al-atreh
Edayin sheshbatztzar dech ata yehav ushshayya di-vet elaha di virushlem umin-edayin vead-kean mitbene vela shelim
Uchan hen al-malka tav yitbakkar bevet ginzayya di-malka tamma di bevavel hen itay di-min-koresh malka sim teem lemivne bet-elaha dech birushlem urut malka al-dena yishlach alena
Bedayin daryavesh malka sam teem uvakkaru bevet sifrayya di ginzayya mehachatin tamma bevavel
Vehishtechach beachmeta bevirta di bemaday medinta megilla chada vechen-ketiv begavah dichrona
Bishnat chada lechoresh malka koresh malka sam teem bet-elaha virushlem bayeta yitbene atar di-davchin divchin veushshohi mesovlin rumeh ammin shittin petayeh ammin shittin
Nidbachin di-even gelal telata venidbach di-a chadat venifketa min-bet malka tityehiv
Veaf mane vet-elaha di dahava vechaspa di nevuchadnetztzar hanpek min-hechla di-virushlem vehevel levavel yahativun vihach lehechla di-virushlem leatreh vetachet bevet elaha
Kean tattenay pachat avar-nahara shetar boznay uchnavathon afarsechaye di baavar nahara rachikin hao min-tamma
Shevuku laavidat bet-elaha dech pachat yehudaye ulsave yehudaye bet-elaha dech yivnon al-atreh
Uminni sim teem lema di-taavdun im-save yehudaye illech lemivne bet-elaha dech uminnichse malka di middat avar nahara asparna nifketa teheve mityahava leguvrayya illech di-la levattala
Uma chashchan uvne torin vedichrin veimmerin laalavan leelah shemayya chintin melach chamar umshach kememar kahanayya di-virushlem leheve mityehev lehom yom beom di-la shalu
Di-leheon mehakrevin nichochin leelah shemayya umtzallayin lechayye malka uvnohi
Uminni sim teem di chal-enash di yehashne pitgama dena yitnesach a min-bayeteh uzkif yitmeche alohi uvayeteh nevalu yitaved al-dena
Velaha di shakkin shemeh tamma yemaggar kal-melech veam di yishlach yedeh lehashnaya lechabbala bet-elaha dech di virushlem ana daryavesh samet teem asparna yitavid
Edayin tattenay pachat avar-nahara shetar boznay uchnavathon lakovel di-shelach daryavesh malka kenema asparna avadu
Vesave yehudaye banayin umatzlechin binvuat chaggay neviyya uzcharya bar-iddo uvno veshachlilu min-taam elah yisrael umitteem koresh vedaryavesh veartachshaste melech paras
Veshetzi bayeta dena ad yom telata lirach adar di-hi shenat-shet lemalchut daryavesh malka
Vaavadu vene-yisrael kahanayya velevaye ushar bene-galuta chanukkat bet-elaha dena bechedva
Vehakrivu lachanukkat bet-elaha dena torin mea dichrin matayin immerin arba mea utzfire izzin lechattaa al-kal-yisrael tere-asar leminyan shivte yisrael
Vahakimu chahanayya bifluggathon velevaye bemachlekathon al-avidat elaha di virushlem kichtav sefar moshe
Vayyaasu vene-haggola et-happasach bearbaa asar lachodesh harishon
Ki hittaharu hakkohanim vehalviyyim keechad kullam tehorim vayyishchatu happesach lechal-bene haggola velaachehem hakkohanim velahem
Vayyochlu vene-yisrael hashshavim mehaggola vechol hannivdal mittumat goye-haaretz alehem lidrosh la-Adonai elohe yisrael
Vayyaasu chag-matztzot shivat yamim besimcha ki simmecham Adonai vehesev lev melech-ashshur alehem lechazzek yedehem bimlechet bet-haelohim elohe yisrael
Veachar haddevarim haelle bemalchut artachshaste melech-paras ezra ben-seraya ben-azarya ben-chilkiyya
Ben-shallum ben-tzadok ben-achituv
Ben-amarya ven-azarya ben-meraot
Ben-zerachya ven-uzzi ben-bukki
Ben-avishua ben-pinchas ben-elazar ben-aharon hakkohen harosh
Hu ezra ala mibbavel vehu-sofer mahir betorat moshe asher-natan Adonai elohe yisrael vayyitten-lo hammelech keyad-Adonai elohav alav kol bakkashato
Vayyaalu mibbene-yisrael umin-hakkohanim vehalviyyim vehamshorrim vehashshoarim vehannetinim el-yerushalam bishnat-sheva leartachshaste hammelech
Vayyavo yerushalam bachodesh hachamishi hi shenat hashsheviit lammelech
Ki beechad lachodesh harishon hu yesud hammaala mibbavel uvechad lachodesh hachamishi ba el-yerushalam keyad-elohav hattova alav
Ki ezra hechin levavo lidrosh et-torat Adonai velaasot ullammed beyisrael chok umishpat
Veze parshegen hannishtevan asher natan hammelech artachshaste leezra hakkohen hassofer sofer divre mitzot-Adonai vechukkav al-yisrael
Artachshaste melech malchayya leezra chahana safar data di-elah shemayya gemir uchenet
Minni sim teem di chal-mitnaddav bemalchuti min-amma yisrael vechahanohi velevaye limhach lirushlem immach yehach
Kal-kovel di min-kodam malka veshivat yaatohi sheliach levakkara al-yehud velirushlem bedat elahach di vidach
Ulhevala kesaf udhav di-malka veyaatohi hitnaddavu leelah yisrael di virushlem mishkeneh
Vechol kesaf udhav di tehashkach bechol medinat bavel im hitnaddavut amma vechahanayya mitnaddevin levet elahahom di virushlem
Kal-kovel dena asparna tikne bechaspa dena torin dichrin immerin uminchathon veniskehon utkarev himmo al-madbecha di bet elahachom di virushlem
Uma di alach echach yetav bishar kaspa vedahava lemebad kirut elahachom taavdun
Umanayya di-mityahavin lach lefalchan bet elahach hashlem kodam elah yerushlem
Ushar chashchut bet elahach di yippel-lach lemintan tinten min-bet ginze malka
Uminni ana artachshaste malka sim teem lechol gizzavrayya di baavar nahara di chal-di yishalenchon ezra chahana safar data di-elah shemayya asparna yitavid
Ad-kesaf kakkerin mea vead-chintin korin mea vead-chamar battin mea vead-battin meshach mea umlach di-la chetav
Kal-di min-taam elah shemayya yitaved adrazda levet elah shemayya di-lema leheve ketzaf al-malchut malka uvnohi
Ulchom mehodin di chal-kahanayya velevaye zammarayya taraayya netinayya ufalche bet elaha dena minda velo vahalach la shallit lemirme alehom
Veante ezra kechachmat elahach di-vidach menni shaftin vedayyanin di-leheon dayenin lechal-amma di baavar nahara lechal-yade date elahach vedi la yada tehodun
Vechal-di-la leheve aved data di-elahach vedata di malka asparna dina leheve mitaved minneh hen lemot hen lishroshi hen-laanash nichsin veleesurin
Baruch Adonai elohe avotenu asher natan kazot belev hammelech lefaer et-bet Adonai asher birushalam
Vealay hitta-chesed lifne hammelech veoatzav ulchal-sare hammelech haggibborim vaani hitchazzakti keyad-Adonai elohay alay vaekbetza miyyisrael rashim laalot immi
Veelle rashe avotehem vehityachsam haolim immi bemalchut artachshaste hammelech mibbavel
Mibbene finchas gershom s mibbene itamar daniyyel s mibbene david chattush
Mibbene shechanya s mibbene farosh zecharya veimmo hityaches lizcharim mea vachamishshim
Mibbene pachat moav elyehoenay ben-zerachya veimmo matayim hazzecharim
Mibbene shechanya ben-yachaziel veimmo shelosh meot hazzecharim
Umibbene adin eved ben-yonatan veimmo chamishshim hazzecharim
Umibbene elam yeshaya ben-atalya veimmo shivim hazzecharim
Umibbene shefatya zevadya ben-michael veimmo shemonim hazzecharim
Mibbene yoav ovadya ben-yechiel veimmo matayim ushmona asar hazzecharim
Umibbene shelomit ben-yosifya veimmo mea veshishshim hazzecharim
Umibbene vevay zecharya ben-bevay veimmo esrim ushmona hazzecharim
Umibbene azgad yochanan ben-hakkatan veimmo mea vaasara hazzecharim
Umibbene adonikam acharonim veelle shemotam elifelet yeiel ushmaya veimmahem shishshim hazzecharim
Umibbene vigvay utay vezakkur veimmo shivim hazzecharim
Vaekbetzem el-hannahar habba el-ahava vannachane sham yamim shelosha vaavina vaam uvakkohanim umibbene levi lo-matzati sham
Vaeshlecha leeliezer laariel lishmaya ulelnatan ulyariv ulelnatan ulnatan velizcharya velimshullam rashim uloyariv ulelnatan mevinim
Vaatzave otam al-iddo harosh bechasifya hammakom vaasima befihem devarim ledabber el-iddo achiv hannetinim bechasifya hammakom lehavi-lanu meshartim levet elohenu
Vayyaviu lanu keyad-elohenu hattova alenu ish sechel mibbene machli ben-levi ben-yisrael vesherevya uvanav veechav shemona asar
Veet-chashavya veitto yeshaya mibbene merari echav uvnehem esrim
Umin-hannetinim shennatan david vehassarim laavodat halviyyim netinim matayim veesrim kullam nikkevu veshemot
Vaekra sham tzom al-hannahar ahava lehitannot lifne elohenu levakkesh mimmennu derech yeshara lanu ultappenu ulchal-rechushenu
Ki voshti lishol min-hammelech chayil ufarashim leazrenu meoyev baddarech ki-amarnu lammelech lemor yad-elohenu al-kal-mevakshav letova veuzzo veappo al kal-ozvav
Vannatzuma vannevaksha meelohenu al-zot vayyeater lanu
Vaavdila missare hakkohanim shenem asar lesherevya chashavya veimmahem meachehem asara
Vaeshkola lahem et-hakkesef veet-hazzahav veet-hakkelim terumat bet-elohenu haherimu hammelech veyoatzav vesarav vechal-yisrael hannimtzaim
Vaeshkala al-yadam kesef kikkarim shesh-meot vachamishshim uchle-chesef mea lechikkarim zahav mea chikkar
Uchfore zahav esrim laadarchonim alef uchle nechoshet mutzhav tova shenayim chamudot kazzahav
Vaomra alehem attem kodesh la-Adonai vehakkelim kodesh vehakkesef vehazzahav nedava la-Adonai elohe avotechem
Shikdu veshimru ad-tishkelu lifne sare hakkohanim vehalviyyim vesare-haavot leyisrael birushalam hallishchot bet Adonai
Vekibbelu hakkohanim vehalviyyim mishkal hakkesef vehazzahav vehakkelim lehavi lirushalam levet elohenu
Vannisa minnehar ahava bishnem asar lachodesh harishon lalechet yerushalam veyad-elohenu hayeta alenu vayyatztzilenu mikkaf oyev veorev al-haddarech
Vannavo yerushalam vanneshev sham yamim shelosha
Uvayyom harvii nishkal hakkesef vehazzahav vehakkelim bevet elohenu al yad-meremot ben-uriyya hakkohen veimmo elazar ben-pinchas veimmahem yozavad ben-yeshua venoadya ven-binnuy halviyyim
Bemispar bemishkal lakkol vayyikkatev kal-hammishkal baet hahi
Habbaim mehashshevi vene-haggola hikrivu olot lelohe yisrael parim shenem-asar al-kal-yisrael elim tishim veshishsha kevasim shivim veshiva tzefire chattat shenem asar hakkol ola la-Adonai
Vayyittenu et-date hammelech laachashdarpene hammelech ufachaot ever hannahar venisseu et-haam veet-bet-haelohim

Uchchallot elle niggeshu elay hassarim lemor lo-nivdelu haam yisrael vehakkohanim vehalviyyim meamme haaratzot ketoavotehem lakkenaani hachitti happerizzi hayevusi haammoni hammoavi hammitzri vehaemori
Ki-nasu mibbenotehem lahem velivnehem vehitarvu zera hakkodesh beamme haaratzot veyad hassarim vehasseganim hayeta bammaal hazze rishona
Uchshami et-haddavar hazze karati et-bigdi umili vaemreta missear roshi uzkani vaeshva meshomem
Veelay yeasfu kol chared bedivre elohe-yisrael al maal haggola vaani yoshev meshomem ad leminchat haarev
Uvminchat haerev kamti mittaaniti uvkari vigdi umili vaechrea al-birkay vaefresa chappay el-Adonai elohay
Vaomra elohay boshti venichlamti leharim elohay panay elecha ki aonotenu ravu lemala rosh veashmatenu gadla ad lashshamayim
Mime avotenu anachnu beashma gedola ad hayyom hazze uvaaonotenu nittannu anachnu melachenu chohanenu beyad malche haaratzot bacherev bashshevi uvabbizza uvvoshet panim kehayyom hazze
Veatta kimat-rega hayeta techinna meet Adonai elohenu lehashir lanu peleta velatet-lanu yated bimkom kadsho lehair enenu elohenu ultittenu michya meat beavdutenu
Ki-avadim anachnu uvavdutenu lo azavanu elohenu vayyat-alenu chesed lifne malche faras latet-lanu michya leromem et-bet elohenu ulhaamid et-charvotav velatet-lanu gader bihuda uvirushalam
Veatta ma-nomar elohenu achare-zot ki azavnu mitzotecha
Asher tzivita beyad avadecha hanneviim lemor haaretz asher attem baim lerishtah eretz nidda hi beniddat amme haaratzot betoavotehem asher miluha mippe el-pe betumatam
Veatta benotechem al-tittenu livnehem uvnotehem al-tisu livnechem velo-tidreshu shelomam vetovatam ad-olam lemaan techezku vaachaltem et-tuv haaretz vehorashtem livnechem ad-olam
Veachare kal-habba alenu bemaasenu haraim uvashmatenu haggedola ki atta elohenu chasachta lematta meaonenu venatatta lanu peleta kazot
Hanashuv lehafer mitzotecha ulhitchatten beamme hattoevot haelle halo teenaf-banu ad-kalle leen sheerit ufleta
Adonai elohe yisrael tzaddik atta ki-nisharnu feleta kehayyom hazze hinnu lefanecha beashmatenu ki en laamod lefanecha al-zot
Uchhitpallel ezra uchhitvaddoto boche umitnappel lifne bet haelohim nikbetzu elav miyyisrael kahal rav-meod anashim venashim viladim ki-vachu haam harbe-veche
Vayyaan shechanya ven-yechiel mibbene elam vayyomer leezra anachnu maalnu velohenu vannoshev nashim nachriyyot meamme haaretz veatta yesh-mikve leyisrael al-zot
Veatta nichrat-berit lelohenu lehotzi chal-nashim vehannolad mehem baatzat adonay vehacharedim bemitzvat elohenu vechattora yease
Kum ki-alecha haddavar vaanachnu immach chazak vaase
Vayyakam ezra vayyashba et-sare hakkohanim halviyyim vechal-yisrael laasot kaddavar hazze vayyishshaveu
Vayyakam ezra millifne bet haelohim vayyelech el-lishkat yehochanan ben-elyashiv vayyelech sham lechem lo-achal umayim lo-shata ki mitabbel al-maal haggola
Vayyaaviru kol bihuda virushalam lechol bene haggola lehikkavetz yerushalam
Vechol asher lo-yavo lishloshet hayyamim kaatzat hassarim vehazzekenim yachoram kal-rechusho vehu yibbadel mikkehal haggola
Vayyikkavtzu chal-anshe-yehuda uvinyamin yerushalam lishloshet hayyamim hu chodesh hatteshii beesrim bachodesh vayyeshvu chal-haam birchov bet haelohim maridim al-haddavar umehaggeshamim
Vayyakam ezra hakkohen vayyomer alehem attem mealtem vattoshivu nashim nachriyyot lehosif al-ashmat yisrael
Veatta tenu toda la-Adonai elohe-avotechem vaasu retzono vehibbadlu meamme haaretz umin-hannashim hannachriyyot
Vayyanu chal-hakkahal vayyomru kol gadol ken kidvarcha alenu laasot
Aval haam rav vehaet geshamim veen koach laamod bachutz vehammelacha lo-leom echad velo lishnayim ki-hirbinu lifshoa baddavar hazze
Yaamdu-na sarenu lechal-hakkahal vechol asher bearenu hahoshiv nashim nachriyyot yavo leittim mezummanim veimmahem zikne-ir vair veshofteha ad lehashiv charon af-elohenu mimmennu ad laddavar hazze
Ach yonatan ben-asahel veyachzeya ven-tikva amdu al-zot umshullam veshabbetay hallevi azarum
Vayyaasu-chen bene haggola vayyibbadlu ezra hakkohen anashim rashe haavot levet avotam vechullam beshemot vayyeshvu beom echad lachodesh haasiri ledarosh haddavar
Vayechallu vakkol anashim hahoshivu nashim nachriyyot ad yom echad lachodesh harishon
Vayyimmatze mibbene hakkohanim asher hoshivu nashim nachriyyot mibbene yeshua ben-yotzadak veechav maaseya veeliezer veyariv ugdalya
Vayyittenu yadam lehotzi neshehem vaashemim el-tzon al-ashmatam
Umibbene immer chanani uzvadya
Umibbene charim maaseya veeliyya ushmaya vichiel veuziyya
Umibbene pashchur eloenay maaseya yishmael netanel yozavad veelasa
Umin-halviyyim yozavad veshimi vekelaya hu kelita petachya yehuda veeliezer
Umin-hamshorrim elyashiv umin-hashshoarim shallum vatelem veuri

Umibbene elam mattanya zecharya vichiel veavdi viremot veeliyya

Umibbene bevay yehochanan chananya zabbay atlay
Umibbene bani meshullam malluch vaadaya yashuv ushal veramot

Kal-elle nasu nashim nachriyyot veyesh mehem nashim vayyasimu banim
Nehemiah: Divre nechemya ben-chachalya vayehi kislev shenat esrim vaani hayiti beshushan habbira
Vayyavo chanani echad meachay hu vaanashim mihuda vaeshalem al-hayehudim happeleta asher-nisharu min-hashshevi veal-yerushalam
Vayyomru li hannisharim asher-nisharu min-hashshevi sham bammedina beraa gedola uvcherpa vechomat yerushalam meforatzet ushareha nitztzetu vaesh
Vayehi keshami et-haddevarim haelle yashavti vaevke vaetabbela yamim vaehi tzam umitpallel lifne elohe hashshamayim
Vaomar anna Adonai elohe hashshamayim hael haggadol vehannora shomer habberit vachesed leohavav ulshomre mitzotav

Tehi na aznecha-kashshevet veenecha fetuuchot lishmoa el-tefillat avdecha asher anochi mitpallel lefanecha hayyom yomam valayela al-bene yisrael avadecha umitvadde al-chattot bene-yisrael asher chatanu lach vaani uvet-avi chatanu
Chavol chavalnu lach velo-shamarnu et-hammitzot veet-hachukkim veet-hammishpatim asher tzivita et-moshe avdecha
Zechar-na et-haddavar asher tzivita et-moshe avdecha lemor attem timalu ani afitz etchem baammim
Veshavtem elay ushmartem mitzotay vaasitem otam im-yihye niddachachem biktze hashshamayim mishsham akabbetzem vahaviotim el-hammakom asher bacharti leshakken et-shemi sham
Vehem avadecha veammecha asher padita bechochacha haggadol uvyadcha hachazaka

Anna adonay tehi na aznecha-kashshevet el-tefillat avdecha veel-tefillat avadecha hachafetzim leyira et-shemecha vehatzlicha-na leavdecha hayyom utnehu lerachamim lifne haish hazze vaani hayiti mashke lammelech
Vayehi bechodesh nisan shenat esrim leartachshaste hammelech yayin lefanav vaessa et-hayyayin vaettena lammelech velo-hayiti ra lefanav
Vayyomer li hammelech maddua panecha raim veatta encha chole en ze ki-im roa lev vaira harbe meod
Vaomar lammelech hammelech leolam yichye maddua lo-yeru fanay asher hair bet-kivrot avotay chareva ushareha ukkelu vaesh
Vayyomer li hammelech al-ma-ze atta mevakkesh vaetpallel el-elohe hashshamayim
Vaomar lammelech im-al-hammelech tov veim-yitav avdecha lefanecha asher tishlacheni el-yehuda el-ir kivrot avotay veevnenna
Vayyomer li hammelech vehashshegal yoshevet etzlo ad-matay yihye mahalachacha umatay tashuv vayyitav lifne-hammelech vayyishlacheni vaettena lo zeman
Vaomar lammelech im-al-hammelech tov iggerot yittenu-li al-pachaot ever hannahar asher yaaviruni ad asher-avo el-yehuda

Veiggeret el-asaf shomer happardes asher lammelech asher yitten-li etzim lekarot et-shaare habbira asher-labbayit ulchomat hair velabbayit asher-avo elav vayyitten-li hammelech keyad-elohay hattova alay
Vaavo el-pachaot ever hannahar vaettena lahem et iggerot hammelech vayyishlach immi hammelech sare chayil ufarashim
Vayyishma sanvallat hachoroni vetoviyya haeved haammoni vayyera lahem raa gedola asher-ba adam levakkesh tova livne yisrael
Vaavo el-yerushalam vaehi-sham yamim shelosha
Vaakum layela ani vaanashim meat immi velo-higgadti leadam ma elohay noten el-libbi laasot lirushalam uvhema en immi ki im-habbehema asher ani rochev bah
Vaetza veshaar-hagga layela veel-pene en hattannin veel-shaar haashpot vaehi sover bechomot yerushalam hem perutzim ushareha ukkelu vaesh
Vaeevor el-shaar haayin veel-berechat hammelech veen-makom labbehema laavor tachtay
Vaehi ole vannachal layela vaehi sover bachoma vaashuv vaavo beshaar haggaye vaashuv
Vehasseganim lo yadu ana halachti uma ani ose velayehudim velakkohanim velachorim velasseganim ulyeter ose hammelacha ad-ken lo higgadti
Vaomar alehem attem roim haraa asher anachnu vah asher yerushalam chareva ushareha nitztzetu vaesh lechu venivne et-chomat yerushalam velo-nihye od cherpa
Vaaggid lahem et-yad elohay asher-hi tova alay veaf-divre hammelech asher amar-li vayyomru nakum uvaninu vayechazzeku yedehem lattova
Vayyishma sanvallat hachoroni vetoviyya haeved haammoni vegeshem haarvi vayyaligu lanu vayyivzu alenu vayyomru ma-haddavar hazze asher attem osim haal hammelech attem mordim
Vaashiv otam davar vaomar lahem elohe hashshamayim hu yatzliach lanu vaanachnu avadav nakum uvaninu velachem en-chelek utzdaka vezikkaron birushalam
Vayyakam elyashiv hakkohen haggadol veechav hakkohanim vayyivnu et-shaar hatztzon hemma kiddeshuhu vayyaamidu daltotav vead-migdal hammea kiddeshuhu ad migdal chananel
Veal-yado vanu anshe yerecho s veal-yado vana zakkur ben-imri
Veet shaar haddagim banu bene hassenaa hemma keruhu vayyaamidu daltotav manulav uvrichav
Veal-yadam hechezik meremot ben-uriyya ben-hakkotz s veal-yadam hechezik meshullam ben-berechya ben-meshezavel s veal-yadam hechezik tzadok ben-baana
Veal-yadam hecheziku hattekoim veaddirehem lo-heviu tzavaram baavodat adonehem

Lechezir shiva asar lehappitztzetz shemona asar
Liftachya tisha asar lichezkel haesrim

Lidlayahu shelosha veesrim lemaazyahu arbaa veesrim
Elle fekuddatam laavodatam lavo levet-Adonai kemishpatam beyad aharon avihem kaasher tzivahu Adonai elohe yisrael
Velivne levi hannotarim livne amram shuvael livne shuvael yechdeyahu
Lirchavyahu livne rechavyahu harosh yishshiyya
Layyitzhari shelomot livne shelomot yachat
Uvnay yeriyyahu amaryahu hashsheni yachaziel hashshelishi yekamam harvii
Bene uzziel micha livne micha shamir
Achi micha yishshiyya livne yishshiyya zecharyahu
Bene merari machli umushi bene yaaziyyahu veno
Bene merari leyaaziyyahu veno veshoham vezakkur veivri
Lemachli elazar velo-haya lo banim
Lekish bene-kish yerachmeel
Uvne mushi machli veeder virimot elle bene halviyyim levet avotehem
Vayyappilu gam-hem goralot leummat achehem bene-aharon lifne david hammelech vetzadok vaachimelech verashe haavot lakkohanim velalviyyim avot harosh leummat achiv hakkatan
Vayyavdel david vesare hatztzava laavoda livne asaf veheman vidutun hannibbeim bechinnorot binvalim uvimtziltayim vayehi misparam anshe melacha laavodatam
Livne asaf zakkur veosef untanya vaasarela bene asaf al yad-asaf hannibba al-yede hammelech
Lidutun bene yedutun gedalyahu utzri vishayahu chashavyahu umattityahu shishsha al yede avihem yedutun bakkinnor hannibba al-hodot vehallel la-Adonai
Leheman bene heman bukkiyyahu mattanyahu uzziel shevuel virimot chananya chanani eliata giddalti veromamti ezer yashbekasha malloti hotir machaziot
Kal-elle vanim leheman choze hammelech bedivre haelohim leharim karen vayyitten haelohim leheman banim arbaa asar uvanot shalosh
Kal-elle al-yede avihem bashshir bet Adonai bimtziltayim nevalim vechinnorot laavodat bet haelohim al yede hammelech s asaf vidutun veheman
Vayehi misparam im-achehem melummede-shir la-Adonai kal-hammevin matayim shemonim ushmona
Vayyappilu goralot mishmeret leummat kakkaton kaggadol mevin im-talmid
Vayyetze haggoral harishon leasaf leosef gedalyahu hashsheni hu-veechav uvanav shenem asar
Hashshelishi zakkur banav veechav shenem asar
Harvii layyitzri banav veechav shenem asar
Hachamishi netanyahu banav veechav shenem asar
Hashshishshi vukkiyyahu banav veechav shenem asar
Hashshevii yesarela banav veechav shenem asar
Hashshemini yeshayahu banav veechav shenem asar
Hatteshii mattanyahu banav veechav shenem asar
Haasiri shimi banav veechav shenem asar
Ashte-asar azarel banav veechav shenem asar
Hashshenem asar lachashavya banav veechav shenem asar
Lishlosha asar shuvael banav veechav shenem asar
Learbaa asar mattityahu banav veechav shenem asar
Lachamishsha asar liremot banav veechav shenem asar
Leshishsha asar lachananyahu banav veechav shenem asar

Lishmona asar lachanani banav veechav shenem asar

Lishlosha veesrim lemachaziot banav veechav shenem asar
Learbaa veesrim leromamti azer banav veechav shenem asar
Lemachlekot leshoarim lakkarchim meshelemyahu ven-kore min-bene asaf
Velimshelemyahu banim zecharyahu habbechor yediael hashsheni zevadyahu hashshelishi yatniel harvii
Elam hachamishi yehochanan hashshishshi elyehoenay hashshevii
Uloved edom banim shemaya habbechor yehozavad hashsheni yoach hashshelishi vesachar harvii untanel hachamishi
Ammiel hashshishshi yisashchar hashshevii peulletay hashshemini ki veracho elohim
Velishmaya veno nolad banim hammimshalim levet avihem ki-gibbore chayil hemma
Bene shemaya atni urfael veoved elzavad echav bene-chayil elihu usmachyahu
Kal-elle mibbene oved edom hemma uvnehem vaachehem ish-chayil bakkoach laavoda shishshim ushnayim leoved edom
Velimshelemyahu banim veachim bene-chayil shemona asar
Ulchosa min-bene-merari banim shimri harosh ki lo-haya vechor vayesimehu avihu lerosh
Chilkiyyahu hashsheni tevalyahu hashshelishi zecharyahu harvii kal-banim veachim lechosa shelosha asar
Leelle machlekot hashshoarim lerashe haggevarim mishmarot leummat achehem lesharet bevet Adonai
Vayyappilu goralot kakkaton kaggadol levet avotam leshaar vashaar
Vayyippol haggoral mizracha leshelemyahu uzcharyahu veno yoetz besechel hippilu goralot vayyetze goralo tzafona
Leoved edom negba ulvanav bet haasuppim
Leshuppim ulchosa lammaarav im shaar shallechet bamsilla haola mishmar leummat mishmar
Lammizrach halviyyim shishsha latztzafona layyom arbaa lannegba layyom arbaa velaasuppim shenayim shenayim
Lapparbar lammaarav arbaa lamsilla shenayim lapparbar
Elle machlekot hashshoarim livne hakkarchi velivne merari
Vehalviyyim achiyya al-otzrot bet haelohim ulotzrot hakkodashim
Bene ladan bene haggershunni leladan rashe haavot leladan haggershunni yechieli
Bene yechieli zetam veoel achiv al-otzrot bet Adonai
Laamrami layyitzhari lachevroni laazzieli
Ushvuel ben-gershom ben-moshe nagid al-haotzarot
Veechav leeliezer rechavyahu veno vishayahu veno veyoram beno vezichri veno ushlomit beno
Hu shelomot veechav al kal-otzrot hakkodashim asher hikdish david hammelech verashe haavot lesare-haalafim vehammeot vesare hatztzava
Min-hammilchamot umin-hashshalal hikdishu lechazzek levet Adonai
Vechol hahikdish shemuel haroe veshaul ben-kish veavner ben-ner veoav ben-tzeruya kol hammakdish al yad-shelomit veechav
Layyitzhari kenanyahu uvanav lammelacha hachitzona al-yisrael leshotrim ulshoftim
Lachevroni chashavyahu veechav bene-chayil elef ushva-meot al pekuddat yisrael meever layyarden marava lechol melechet Adonai velaavodat hammelech
Lachevroni yeriyya harosh lachevroni letoldotav leavot bishnat haarbaim lemalchut david nidrashu vayyimmatze vahem gibbore chayil beyazer gilad
Veechav bene-chayil alpayim ushva meot rashe haavot vayyafkidem david hammelech al-haruveni vehaggadi vachatzi shevet hamnashshi lechal-devar haelohim udvar hammelech

Uvne yisrael lemisparam rashe haavot vesare haalafim vehammeot veshotrehem hamshartim et-hammelech lechol devar hammachlekot habbaa vehayyotzet chodesh bechodesh lechol chadshe hashshana hammachaloket haachat esrim vearbaa alef
Al hammachaloket harishona lachodesh harishon yashavam ben-zavdiel veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Min-bene-feretz harosh lechal-sare hatztzevaot lachodesh harishon
Veal machaloket hachodesh hashsheni doday haachochi umachalukto umiklot hannagid veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Sar hatztzava hashshelishi lachodesh hashshelishi benayahu ven-yehoyada hakkohen rosh veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Hu venayahu gibbor hashsheloshim veal-hashsheloshim umachalukto ammizavad beno
Harvii lachodesh harvii asa-el achi yoav uzvadya veno acharav veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Hachamishi lachodesh hachamishi hassar shamhut hayyizrach veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Hashshishshi lachodesh hashshishshi ira ven-ikkesh hattekoi veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Hashshevii lachodesh hashshevii cheletz happeloni min-bene efrayim veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Hashshemini lachodesh hashshemini sibbechay hachushati lazzarchi veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Hatteshii lachodesh hatteshii aviezer haannetoti labben yemini veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Haasiri lachodesh haasiri mahray hannetofati lazzarchi veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Ashte-asar leashte-asar hachodesh benaya happiratoni min-bene efrayim veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Hashshenem asar lishnem asar hachodesh chelday hannetofati leatniel veal machalukto esrim vearbaa alef
Veal shivte yisrael laruveni nagid eliezer ben-zichri s lashshimoni shefatyahu ben-maacha
Lelevi chashavya ven-kemuel leaharon tzadok
Lihuda elihu meache david leyisashchar amri ben-michael
Lizvulun yishmayahu ben-ovadyahu lenaftali yerimot ben-azriel
Livne efrayim hoshea ben-azazyahu lachatzi shevet menashshe yoel ben-pedayahu
Lachatzi hamnashshe gilada yiddo ben-zecharyahu s levinyamin yaasiel ben-avner
Ledan azarel ben-yerocham elle sare shivte yisrael
Velo-nasa david misparam lemibben esrim shana ulmatta ki amar Adonai leharbot et-yisrael kechochve hashshamayim
Yoav ben-tzeruya hechel limnot velo chilla vayehi vazot ketzef al-yisrael velo ala hammispar bemispar divre-hayyamim lammelech david
Veal otzrot hammelech azmavet ben-adiel s veal haotzarot bassade bearim uvakkefarim uvammigdalot yehonatan ben-uzziyyahu
Veal ose melechet hassade laavodat haadama ezri ben-keluv
Veal-hakkeramim shimi haramati veal shebbakkeramim leotzrot hayyayin zavdi hashshifmi
Veal-hazzetim vehashshikmim asher bashshefela baal chanan haggederi s veal-otzrot hashshemen yoash
Veal-habbakar haroim bashsharon shirtay hashsharoni veal-habbakar baamakim shafat ben-adlay
Veal-haggemallim ovil hayyishmeeli veal-haatonot yechdeyahu hammeronoti
Veal-hatztzon yaziz hahagri kal-elle sare harchush asher lammelech david
Vihonatan dod-david yoetz ish-mevin vesofer hu vichiel ben-chachmoni im-bene hammelech
Vaachitofel yoetz lammelech s vechushay haarki rea hammelech
Veachare achitofel yehoyada ben-benayahu veevyatar vesar-tzava lammelech yoav

Vayyakhel david et-kal-sare yisrael sare hashshevatim vesare hammachlekot hamshartim et-hammelech vesare haalafim vesare hammeot vesare chal-rechush-umikne lammelech ulvanav im-hassarisim vehaggibborim ulchal-gibbor chayil el-yerushalam
Vayyakam david hammelech al-raglav vayyomer shemauni achay veammi ani im-levavi livnot bet menucha laaron berit-Adonai velahadom ragle elohenu vahachinoti livnot
Vehaelohim amar li lo-tivne vayit lishmi ki ish milchamot atta vedamim shafachta
Vayyivchar Adonai elohe yisrael bi mikkol bet-avi lihot lemelech al-yisrael leolam ki vihuda bachar lenagid uvvet yehuda bet avi uvivne avi bi ratza lehamlich al-kal-yisrael
Umikkal-banay ki rabbim banim natan li Adonai vayyivchar bishlomo veni lashevet al-kisse malchut Adonai al-yisrael
Vayyomer li shelomo vincha hu-yivne veti vachatzerotay ki-vacharti vo li leven vaani ehye-lo leav
Vahachinoti et-malchuto ad-leolam im-yechezak laasot mitzotay umishpatay kayyom hazze
Veatta leene chal-yisrael kehal-Adonai uvazne elohenu shimru vedirshu kal-mitzot Adonai elohechem lemaan tirshu et-haaretz hattova vehinchaltem livnechem acharechem ad-olam

Veatta shelomo-veni da et-elohe avicha veavdehu belev shalem uvnefesh chafetza ki chal-levavot doresh Adonai vechal-yetzer machashavot mevin im-tidreshennu yimmatze lach veim-taazvennu yaznichacha laad
Ree atta ki-Adonai bachar becha livnot-bayit lammikdash chazak vaase
Vayyitten david lishlomo veno et-tavnit haulam veet-battav veganzakkav vaaliyyotav vachadarav happenimim uvet hakkapporet
Vetavnit kol asher haya varuach immo lechatzrot bet-Adonai ulchal-halleshachot saviv leotzrot bet haelohim ulotzrot hakkodashim
Ulmachlekot hakkohanim vehalviyyim ulchal-melechet avodat bet-Adonai ulchal-kele avodat bet-Adonai
Lazzahav bammishkal lazzahav lechal-kele avoda vaavoda lechol kele hakkesef bemishkal lechal-kele avoda vaavoda
Umishkal limnorot hazzahav venerotehem zahav bemishkal-menora umnora veneroteha velimnorot hakkesef bemishkal limnora veneroteha kaavodat menora umnora
Veet-hazzahav mishkal leshulchanot hammaarechet leshulchan veshulchan vechesef leshulchanot hakkasef
Vehammizlagot vehammizrakot vehakkesaot zahav tahor velichfore hazzahav bemishkal lichfor uchfor velichfore hakkesef bemishkal lichfor uchfor
Ulmizbach hakketoret zahav mezukkak bammishkal ultavnit hammerkava hakkeruvim zahav leforsim vesochchim al-aron berit-Adonai
Hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil kol malachot hattavnit
Vayyomer david lishlomo veno chazak veematz vaase al-tira veal-techat ki Adonai elohim elohay immach lo yarpecha velo yaazvekka ad-lichlot kal-melechet avodat bet-Adonai
Vehinne machlekot hakkohanim vehalviyyim lechal-avodat bet haelohim veimmecha vechal-melacha lechal-nadiv bachachma lechal-avoda vehassarim vechal-haam lechal-devarecha
Vayyomer david hammelech lechal-hakkahal shelomo veni echad bachar-bo elohim naar varach vehammelacha gedola ki lo leadam habbira ki la-Adonai elohim

Uchchal-kochi hachinoti levet-elohay hazzahav lazzahav vehakkesef lakkesef vehannechoshet lannechoshet habbarzel labbarzel vehaetzim laetzim avne-shoham umilluim avne-fuch verikma vechol even yekara veavne-shayish larov
Veod birtzoti bevet elohay yesh-li segulla zahav vachasef natatti levet-elohay lemala mikkal-hachinoti levet hakkodesh
Sheloshet alafim kikkere zahav mizzehav ofir veshivat alafim kikkar-kesef mezukkak latuach kirot habbattim
Lazzahav lazzahav velakkesef lakkesef ulchal-melacha beyad charashim umi mitnaddev lemallot yado hayyom la-Adonai
Vayyitnaddevu sare haavot vesare shivte yisrael vesare haalafim vehammeot ulsare melechet hammelech
Vayyittenu laavodat bet-haelohim zahav kikkarim chameshet-alafim vaadarchonim ribbo vechesef kikkarim aseret alafim unchoshet ribbo ushmonat alafim kikkarim uvarzel mea-elef kikkarim
Vehannimtza itto avanim natnu leotzar bet-Adonai al yad-yechiel haggershunni
Vayyismechu haam al-hitnaddevam ki belev shalem hitnaddevu la-Adonai vegam david hammelech samach simcha gedola
Vayevarech david et-Adonai leene kal-hakkahal vayyomer david baruch atta Adonai elohe yisrael avinu meolam vead-olam
Lecha Adonai haggedulla vehaggevura vehattiferet vehannetzach vehahod ki-chol bashshamayim uvaaretz lecha Adonai hammamlacha vehammitnasse lechol lerosh
Vehaosher vehakkavod millefanecha veatta moshel bakkol uvyadcha koach ugvura uvyadcha legaddel ulchazzek lakkol
Veatta elohenu modim anachnu lach umhallim leshem tifartecha
Vechi mi ani umi ammi ki-natzor koach lehitnaddev kazot ki-mimmecha hakkol umiyyadcha natannu lach
Ki-gerim anachnu lefanecha vetoshavim kechal-avotenu katztzel yamenu al-haaretz veen mikve
Adonai elohenu kol hehamon hazze asher hachinonu livnot-lecha vayit leshem kadshecha miyyadcha hu ulcha hakkol
Veyadati elohay ki atta bochen levav umesharim tirtze ani beyosher levavi hitnaddavti chal-elle veatta ammecha hannimtzeu-fo raiti vesimcha lehitnaddev-lach
Adonai elohe avraham yitzchak veyisrael avotenu shomra-zot leolam leyetzer machshevot levav ammecha vehachen levavam elecha
Velishlomo veni ten levav shalem lishmor mitzotecha edotecha vechukkecha velaasot hakkol velivnot habbira asher-hachinoti
Vayyomer david lechal-hakkahal barchu-na et-Adonai elohechem vayevarachu chal-hakkahal la-Adonai elohe avotehem vayyikkedu vayyishtachau la-Adonai velammelech
Vayyizbechu la-Adonai zevachim vayyaalu olot la-Adonai lemachorat hayyom hahu parim elef elim elef kevasim elef veniskehem uzvachim larov lechal-yisrael
Vayyochlu vayyishtu lifne Adonai bayyom hahu besimcha gedola vayyamlichu shenit lishlomo ven-david vayyimshechu la-Adonai lenagid ultzadok lechohen
Vayyeshev shelomo al-kisse Adonai lemelech tachat-david aviv vayyatzlach vayyishmeu elav kal-yisrael
Vechal-hassarim vehaggibborim vegam kal-bene hammelech david natnu yad tachat shelomo hammelech
Vayegaddel Adonai et-shelomo lemala leene kal-yisrael vayyitten alav hod malchut asher lo-haya al-kal-melech lefanav al-yisrael
Vedavid ben-yishay malach al-kal-yisrael
Vehayyamim asher malach al-yisrael arbaim shana bechevron malach sheva shanim uvirushalam malach sheloshim veshalosh
Vayyamat beseva tova seva yamim osher vechavod vayyimloch shelomo veno tachtav
Vedivre david hammelech harishonim vehaacharonim hinnam ketuvim al-divre shemuel haroe veal-divre natan hannavi veal-divre gad hachoze
Im kal-malchuto ugvurato vehaittim asher avru alav veal-yisrael veal kal-mamlechot haaratzot
II Chronicles: Vayyitchazzek shelomo ven-david al-malchuto va-Adonai elohav immo vayegaddelehu lemala
Vayyomer shelomo lechal-yisrael lesare haalafim vehammeot velashshoftim ulchol nasi lechal-yisrael rashe haavot
Vayyelchu shelomo vechal-hakkahal immo labbama asher begivon ki-sham haya ohel moed haelohim asher asa moshe eved-Adonai bammidbar
Aval aron haelohim heela david mikkiryat yearim bahechin lo david ki nata-lo ohel birushalam
Umizbach hannechoshet asher asa betzalel ben-uri ven-chur sam lifne mishkan Adonai vayyidreshehu shelomo vehakkahal
Vayyaal shelomo sham al-mizbach hannechoshet lifne Adonai asher leohel moed vayyaal alav olot alef
Ballayela hahu nira elohim lishlomo vayyomer lo sheal ma etten-lach
Vayyomer shelomo lelohim atta asita im-david avi chesed gadol vehimlachtani tachtav
Atta Adonai elohim yeamen devarcha im david avi ki atta himlachtani al-am rav kaafar haaretz
Atta chachma umadda ten-li veetza lifne haam-hazze veavoa ki-mi yishpot et-ammecha hazze haggadol

Vayyomer-elohim lishlomo yaan asher hayeta zot im-levavecha velo-shaalta osher nechasim vechavod veet nefesh sonecha vegam-yamim rabbim lo shaalta vattishal-lecha chachma umadda asher tishpot et-ammi asher himlachticha alav
Hachachma vehammadda natun lach veosher unchasim vechavod etten-lach asher lo-haya chen lammelachim asher lefanecha veacharecha lo yihye-ken
Vayyavo shelomo labbama asher-begivon yerushalam millifne ohel moed vayyimloch al-yisrael
Vayyeesof shelomo rechev ufarashim vayehi-lo elef vearba-meot rechev ushnem-asar elef parashim vayyannichem beare harechev veim-hammelech birushalam
Vayyitten hammelech et-hakkesef veet-hazzahav birushalam kaavanim veet haarazim natan kashshikmim asher-bashshefela larov
Umotza hassusim asher lishlomo mimmitzrayim umikve sochare hammelech mikve yikchu bimchir
Vayyaalu vayyotziu mimmitzrayim merkava beshesh meot kesef vesus bachamishshim umea vechen lechal-malche hachittim umalche aram beyadam yotziu
Vayyomer shelomo livnot bayit leshem Adonai uvayit lemalchuto
Vayyispor shelomo shivim elef ish sabbal ushmonim elef ish chotzev bahar umnatztzechim alehem sheloshet alafim veshesh meot
Vayyishlach shelomo el-churam melech-tzor lemor kaasher asita im-david avi vattishlach-lo arazim livnot-lo vayit lashevet bo

Hinne ani vone-bayit leshem Adonai elohay lehakdish lo lehaktir lefanav ketoret-sammim umaarechet tamid veolot labboker velaerev lashshabbatot velechodashim ulmoade Adonai elohenu leolam zot al-yisrael
Vehabbayit asher-ani vone gadol ki-gadol elohenu mikkal-haelohim
Umi yaatzar-koach livnot-lo vayit ki hashshamayim ushme hashshamayim lo yechalkeluhu umi ani asher evne-lo vayit ki im-lehaktir lefanav

Veatta shelach-li ish-chacham laasot bazzahav uvakkesef uvannechoshet uvabbarzel uvaargevan vecharmil utchelet veyodea lefatteach pittuchim im-hachachamim asher immi bihuda uvirushalam asher hechin david avi
Ushlach-li atze arazim beroshim vealgummim mehallevanon ki ani yadati asher avadecha yodim lichrot atze levanon vehinne avaday im-avadecha
Ulhachin li etzim larov ki habbayit asher-ani vone gadol vehafle
Vehinne lachotvim lechorte haetzim natatti chittim makkot laavadecha korim esrim elef usorim korim esrim alef veyayin battim esrim elef veshemen battim esrim alef
Vayyomer churam melech-tzor bichtav vayyishlach el-shelomo beahavat Adonai et-ammo netancha alehem melech
Vayyomer churam baruch Adonai elohe yisrael asher asa et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz asher natan ledavid hammelech ben chacham yodea sechel uvina asher yivne-bayit la-Adonai uvayit lemalchuto
Veatta shalachti ish-chacham yodea bina lechuram avi

Ben-ishsha min-benot dan veaviv ish-tzori yodea laasot bazzahav-uvakkesef bannechoshet babbarzel baavanim uvaetzim baargaman battechelet uvabbutz uvakkarmil ulfatteach kal-pittuach velachshov kal-machashavet asher yinnaten-lo im-chachamecha vechachme adoni david avicha
Veatta hachittim vehasseorim hashshemen vehayyayin asher amar adoni yishlach laavadav
Vaanachnu nichrot etzim min-hallevanon kechal-tzarkecha unviem lecha rafsodot al-yam yafo veatta taale otam yerushalam
Vayyispor shelomo kal-haanashim haggerim asher beeretz yisrael achare hassefar asher sefaram david aviv vayyimmatzu mea vachamishshim elef ushloshet alafim veshesh meot
Vayyaas mehem shivim elef sabbal ushmonim elef chotzev bahar ushloshet alafim veshesh meot menatztzechim lehaavid et-haam
Vayyachel shelomo livnot et-bet-Adonai birushalam behar hammoriyya asher nira ledavid avihu asher hechin bimkom david begoren arnan hayevusi
Vayyachel livnot bachodesh hashsheni bashsheni bishnat arba lemalchuto
Veelle husad shelomo livnot et-bet haelohim haorech ammot bammidda harishona ammot shishshim verochav ammot esrim
Vehaulam asher al-pene haorech al-pene rochav-habbayit ammot esrim vehaggovah mea veesrim vayetzappehu mippenima zahav tahor
Veet habbayit haggadol chippa etz beroshim vayechappehu zahav tov vayyaal alav timorim vesharsherot
Vayetzaf et-habbayit even yekara letifaret vehazzahav zehav parvayim
Vayechaf et-habbayit hakkorot hassippim vekirotav vedaltotav zahav ufittach keruvim al-hakkirot
Vayyaas et-bet-kodesh hakkodashim arko al-pene rochav-habbayit ammot esrim verachbo ammot esrim vayechappehu zahav tov lechikkarim shesh meot
Umishkal lemismerot lishkalim chamishshim zahav vehaaliyyot chippa zahav
Vayyaas bevet-kodesh hakkodashim keruvim shenayim maase tzaatzuim vayetzappu otam zahav
Vechanfe hakkeruvim arkam ammot esrim kenaf haechad leammot chamesh maggaat lekir habbayit vehakkanaf haacheret ammot chamesh maggia lichnaf hakkeruv haacher
Uchnaf hakkeruv haechad ammot chamesh maggia lekir habbayit vehakkanaf haacheret ammot chamesh deveka lichnaf hakkeruv haacher
Kanfe hakkeruvim haelle porsim ammot esrim vehem omdim al-raglehem ufnehem labbayit
Vayyaas et-happarochet techelet veargaman vecharmil uvutz vayyaal alav keruvim
Vayyaas lifne habbayit ammudim shenayim ammot sheloshim vechamesh orech vehatztzefet asher-al-rosho ammot chamesh
Vayyaas sharsherot baddevir vayyitten al-rosh haammudim vayyaas rimmonim mea vayyitten bashsharsherot
Vayyakem et-haammudim al-pene hahechal echad miyyamin veechad mehassemol vayyikra hayemani yachin veshem hassemali boaz
Vayyaas mizbach nechoshet esrim amma arko veesrim amma rachbo veeser ammot komato
Vayyaas et-hayyam mutzak eser baamma missefato el-sefato agol saviv vechamesh baamma komato vekav sheloshim baamma yasov oto saviv
Udmut bekarim tachat lo saviv saviv sovvim oto eser baamma makkifim et-hayyam saviv shenayim turim habbakar yetzukim bemutzakto
Omed al-shenem asar bakar shelosha fonim tzafona ushlosha fonim yamma ushlosha ponim negba ushlosha ponim mizracha vehayyam alehem milmala vechal-achorehem bayeta
Veavo tefach usfato kemaase sefat-kos perach shoshanna machazik battim sheloshet alafim yachil
Vayyaas kiyyorim asara vayyitten chamishsha miyyamin vachamishsha missemol lerachtza vahem et-maase haola yadichu vam vehayyam lerachtza lakkohanim bo
Vayyaas et-menorot hazzahav eser kemishpatam vayyitten bahechal chamesh miyyamin vechamesh missemol
Vayyaas shulchanot asara vayyannach bahechal chamishsha miyyamin vachamishsha missemol vayyaas mizreke zahav mea
Vayyaas chatzar hakkohanim vehaazara haggedola udlatot laazara vedaltotehem tzippa nechoshet
Veet-hayyam natan mikketef hayemanit kedma mimmul negba
Vayyaas churam et-hassirot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizrakot s vayechal churam laasot et-hammelacha asher asa lammelech shelomo bevet haelohim
Ammudim shenayim vehaggullot vehakkotarot al-rosh haammudim shettayim vehassevachot shettayim lechassot et-shette gullot hakkotarot asher al-rosh haammudim
Veet-harimmonim arba meot lishte hassevachot shenayim turim rimmonim lassevacha haechat lechassot et-shette gullot hakkotarot asher al-pene haammudim
Veet-hammechonot asa veet-hakkiyyorot asa al-hammechonot
Et-hayyam echad veet-habbakar shenem-asar tachtav
Veet-hassirot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizlagot veet-kal-kelehem asa churam aviv lammelech shelomo levet Adonai nechoshet maruk
Bechikkar hayyarden yetzakam hammelech baavi haadama ben sukkot uven tzeredata
Vayyaas shelomo kal-hakkelim haelle larov meod ki lo nechkar mishkal hannechoshet
Vayyaas shelomo et kal-hakkelim asher bet haelohim veet mizbach hazzahav veet-hashshulchanot vaalehem lechem happanim
Veet-hammenorot venerotehem levaaram kammishpat lifne haddevir zahav sagur
Vehapperach vehannerot vehammelkachayim zahav hu michlot zahav
Vehamzammerot vehammizrakot vehakkappot vehammachtot zahav sagur ufetach habbayit daltotav happenimiyyot lekodesh hakkodashim vedalte habbayit lahechal zahav
Vattishlam kal-hammelacha asher-asa shelomo levet Adonai s vayyave shelomo et-kadshe david aviv veet-hakkesef veet-hazzahav veet-kal-hakkelim natan beotzrot bet haelohim
Az yakhel shelomo et-zikne yisrael veet-kal-rashe hammattot nesie haavot livne yisrael el-yerushalam lehaalot et-aron berit-Adonai meir david hi tziyyon
Vayyikkahalu el-hammelech kal-ish yisrael bechag hu hachodesh hashshevii
Vayyavou kol zikne yisrael vayyisu halviyyim et-haaron
Vayyaalu et-haaron veet-ohel moed veet-kal-kele hakkodesh asher baohel heelu otam hakkohanim halviyyim
Vehammelech shelomo vechal-adat yisrael hannoadim alav lifne haaron mezabbechim tzon uvakar asher lo-yissafru velo yimmanu merov
Vayyaviu hakkohanim et-aron berit-Adonai el-mekomo el-devir habbayit el-kodesh hakkedashim el-tachat kanfe hakkeruvim
Vayyihu hakkeruvim porsim kenafayim al-mekom haaron vayechassu hakkeruvim al-haaron veal-baddav milmala
Vayyaarichu habbaddim vayyerau rashe habbaddim min-haaron al-pene haddevir velo yerau hachutza vayehi-sham ad hayyom hazze
En baaron rak shene halluchot asher-natan moshe bechorev asher karat Adonai im-bene yisrael betzetam mimmitzrayim
Vayehi betzet hakkohanim min-hakkodesh ki kal-hakkohanim hannimtzeim hitkaddashu en lishmor lemachlekot

Vehalviyyim hamshorarim lechullam leasaf leheman lidutun velivnehem velaachehem melubbashim butz bimtziltayim uvinvalim vechinnorot omdim mizrach lammizbeach veimmahem kohanim lemea veesrim machtzerim bachatzotzrot

Vayehi cheechad lamchatztzerim velamshorarim lehashmia kol-echad lehallel ulhodot la-Adonai uchharim kol bachatzotzrot uvimtziltayim uvichle hashshir uvhallel la-Adonai ki tov ki leolam chasdo vehabbayit male anan bet Adonai
Velo-yachlu hakkohanim laamod lesharet mippene heanan ki-male chevod-Adonai et-bet haelohim
Az amar shelomo Adonai amar lishkon baarafel
Vaani baniti vet-zevul lach umachon leshivtecha olamim
Vayyassev hammelech et-panav vayevarech et kal-kehal yisrael vechal-kehal yisrael omed
Vayyomer baruch Adonai elohe yisrael asher dibber befiv et david avi uvyadav mille lemor
Min-hayyom asher hotzeti et-ammi meeretz mitzrayim lo-vacharti veir mikkol shivte yisrael livnot bayit lihot shemi sham velo-vacharti veish lihot nagid al-ammi yisrael
Vaevchar birushalam lihot shemi sham vaevchar bedavid lihot al-ammi yisrael
Vayehi im-levav david avi livnot bayit leshem Adonai elohe yisrael
Vayyomer Adonai el-david avi yaan asher haya im-levavcha livnot bayit lishmi hetivota ki haya im-levavecha
Rak atta lo tivne habbayit ki vincha hayyotze mechalatzecha hu-yivne habbayit lishmi
Vayyakem Adonai et-devaro asher dibber vaakum tachat david avi vaeshev al-kisse yisrael kaasher dibber Adonai vaevne habbayit leshem Adonai elohe yisrael
Vaasim sham et-haaron asher-sham berit Adonai asher karat im-bene yisrael
Vayyaamod lifne mizbach Adonai neged kal-kehal yisrael vayyifros kappav

Ki-asa shelomo kiyyor nechoshet vayyittenehu betoch haazara chamesh ammot arko vechamesh ammot rachbo veammot shalosh komato vayyaamod alav vayyivrach al-birkav neged kal-kehal yisrael vayyifros kappav hashshamayema
Vayyomar Adonai elohe yisrael en-kamocha elohim bashshamayim uvaaretz shomer habberit vehachesed laavadecha haholchim lefanecha bechal-libbam
Asher shamarta leavdecha david avi et asher-dibbarta lo vattedabber beficha uvyadcha milleta kayyom hazze

Veatta Adonai elohe yisrael shemor leavdecha david avi et asher dibbarta lo lemor lo-yikkaret lecha ish millefanay yoshev al-kisse yisrael rak im-yishmeru vanecha et-darkam lalechet betorati kaasher halachta lefanay
Veatta Adonai elohe yisrael yeamen devarcha asher dibbarta leavdecha ledavid
Ki haumnam yeshev elohim et-haadam al-haaretz hinne shamayim ushme hashshamayim lo yechalkelucha af ki-habbayit hazze asher baniti
Ufanita el-tefillat avdecha veel-techinnato Adonai elohay lishmoa el-harinna veel-hattefilla asher avdecha mitpallel lefanecha
Lihot enecha fetuchot el-habbayit hazze yomam valayela el-hammakom asher amarta lasum shimcha sham lishmoa el-hattefilla asher yitpallel avdecha el-hammakom hazze
Veshamata el-tachanune avdecha veammecha yisrael asher yitpallu el-hammakom hazze veatta tishma mimmekom shivtecha min-hashshamayim veshamata vesalachta
Im-yecheta ish lereehu venasha-vo ala lehaaloto uva ala lifne mizbachacha babbayit hazze
Veatta tishma min-hashshamayim veasita veshafatta et-avadecha lehashiv lerasha latet darko berosho ulhatzdik tzaddik latet lo ketzidkato
Veim-yinnagef ammecha yisrael lifne oyev ki yechetu-lach veshavu vehodu et-shemecha vehitpallu vehitchannenu lefanecha babbayit hazze
Veatta tishma min-hashshamayim vesalachta lechattat ammecha yisrael vahashevotam el-haadama asher-natatta lahem velaavotehem
Beheatzer hashshamayim velo-yihye matar ki yechetu-lach vehitpallu el-hammakom hazze vehodu et-shemecha mechattatam yeshuvun ki taanem
Veatta tishma hashshamayim vesalachta lechattat avadecha veammecha yisrael ki torem el-hadderech hattova asher yelchu-vah venatatta matar al-artzecha asher-natatta leammecha lenachala
Raav ki-yihye vaaretz dever ki-yihye shiddafon veyerakon arbe vechasil ki yihye ki yatzar-lo oyevav beeretz shearav kal-nega vechal-machala
Kal-tefilla chal-techinna asher yihye lechal-haadam ulchol ammecha yisrael asher yedu ish nigo umachovo ufaras kappav el-habbayit hazze
Veatta tishma min-hashshamayim mechon shivtecha vesalachta venatatta laish kechal-derachav asher teda et-levavo ki atta levaddecha yadata et-levav bene haadam
Lemaan yiraucha lalechet bidrachecha kal-hayyamim asher-hem chayyim al-pene haadama asher natatta laavotenu
Vegam el-hannachri asher lo meammecha yisrael hu uva meeretz rechoka lemaan shimcha haggadol veyadcha hachazaka uzroacha hannetuya uvau vehitpallu el-habbayit hazze

Veatta tishma min-hashshamayim mimmechon shivtecha veasita kechol asher-yikra elecha hannachri lemaan yedu chal-amme haaretz et-shemecha ulyira otcha keammecha yisrael veladaat ki-shimcha nikra al-habbayit hazze asher baniti
Ki-yetze ammecha lammilchama al-oyevav badderech asher tishlachem vehitpallu elecha derech hair hazzot asher bacharta bah vehabbayit asher-baniti lishmecha
Veshamata min-hashshamayim et-tefillatam veet-techinnatam veasita mishpatam
Ki yechetu-lach ki en adam asher lo-yecheta veanafta vam untattam lifne oyev veshavum shovehem el-eretz rechoka o kerova
Veheshivu el-levavam baaretz asher nishbu-sham veshavu vehitchannenu elecha beeretz shivyam lemor chatanu heevinu verashanu
Veshavu elecha bechal-libbam uvchal-nafsham beeretz shivyam asher-shavu otam vehitpallu derech artzam asher natatta laavotam vehair asher bacharta velabbayit asher-baniti lishmecha
Veshamata min-hashshamayim mimmechon shivtecha et-tefillatam veet-techinnotehem veasita mishpatam vesalachta leammecha asher chatu-lach
Atta elohay yihu-na enecha petuchot veaznecha kashshuvot litfillat hammakom hazze
Veatta kuma Adonai elohim lenuchecha atta vaaron uzzecha kohanecha Adonai elohim yilbeshu teshua vachasidecha yismechu vattov
Adonai elohim al-tashev pene meshichecha zachra lechasde david avdecha
Uchchallot shelomo lehitpallel vehaesh yarda mehashshamayim vattochal haola vehazzevachim uchvod Adonai male et-habbayit
Velo yachlu hakkohanim lavo el-bet Adonai ki-male chevod-Adonai et-bet Adonai
Vechol bene yisrael roim beredet haesh uchvod Adonai al-habbayit vayyichreu appayim artza al-haritzfa vayyishtachau vehodot la-Adonai ki tov ki leolam chasdo
Vehammelech vechal-haam zovchim zevach lifne Adonai
Vayyizbach hammelech shelomo et-zevach habbakar esrim ushnayim elef vetzon mea veesrim alef vayyachnechu et-bet haelohim hammelech vechal-haam

Vehakkohanim al-mishmerotam omdim vehalviyyim bichle-shir Adonai asher asa david hammelech lehodot la-Adonai ki-leolam chasdo behallel david beyadam vehakkohanim machtzerim negdam vechal-yisrael omdim

Vayekaddesh shelomo et-toch hechatzer asher lifne vet-Adonai ki-asa sham haolot veet chelve hashshelamim ki-mizbach hannechoshet asher asa shelomo lo yachol lehachil et-haola veet-hammincha veet-hachalavim
Vayyaas shelomo et-hechag baet hahi shivat yamim vechal-yisrael immo kahal gadol meod millevo chamat ad-nachal mitzrayim
Vayyaasu bayyom hashshemini atzaret ki chanukkat hammizbeach asu shivat yamim vehechag shivat yamim
Uvom esrim ushlosha lachodesh hashshevii shillach et-haam leaholehem semechim vetove lev al-hattova asher asa Adonai ledavid velishlomo ulyisrael ammo
Vayechal shelomo et-bet Adonai veet-bet hammelech veet kal-habba al-lev shelomo laasot bevet-Adonai uvveto hitzliach
Vayyera Adonai el-shelomo ballayela vayyomer lo shamati et-tefillatecha uvacharti bammakom hazze li levet zavach
Hen eetzor hashshamayim velo-yihye matar vehen-atzave al-chagav leechol haaretz veim-ashallach dever beammi
Veyikkanu ammi asher nikra-shemi alehem veyitpallu vivakshu fanay veyashuvu middarchehem haraim vaani eshma min-hashshamayim veeslach lechattatam veerpa et-artzam
Atta enay yihu fetuchot veaznay kashshuvot litfillat hammakom hazze
Veatta bacharti vehikdashti et-habbayit hazze lihot-shemi sham ad-olam vehau enay velibbi sham kal-hayyamim
Veatta im-telech lefanay kaasher halach david avicha velaasot kechol asher tziviticha vechukkay umishpatay tishmor
Vahakimoti et kisse malchutecha kaasher karatti ledavid avicha lemor lo-yikkaret lecha ish moshel beyisrael
Veim-teshuvun attem vaazavtem chukkotay umitzotay asher natatti lifnechem vahalachtem vaavadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem
Untashtim meal admati asher natatti lahem veet-habbayit hazze asher hikdashti lishmi ashlich meal panay veettenennu lemashal velishnina bechal-haammim
Vehabbayit hazze asher haya elon lechal-over alav yishshom veamar bamme asa Adonai kacha laaretz hazzot velabbayit hazze
Veamru al asher azvu et-Adonai elohe avotehem asher hotziam meeretz mitzrayim vayyachaziku belohim acherim vayyishtachau lahem vayyaavdum al-ken hevi alehem et kal-haraa hazzot
Vayehi mikketz esrim shana asher bana shelomo et-bet Adonai veet-beto
Vehearim asher natan churam lishlomo bana shelomo otam vayyoshev sham et-bene yisrael
Vayyelech shelomo chamat tzova vayyechezak aleha
Vayyiven et-tadmor bammidbar veet kal-are hammiskenot asher bana bachamat
Vayyiven et-bet choron haelon veet-bet choron hattachton are matzor chomot delatayim uvriach
Veet-baalat veet kal-are hammiskenot asher hau lishlomo veet kal-are harechev veet are happarashim veet kal-cheshek shelomo asher chashak livnot birushalam uvallevanon uvchol eretz memshalto
Kal-haam hannotar min-hachitti vehaemori vehapperizzi vehachivi vehayevusi asher lo miyyisrael hemma
Min-benehem asher notru acharehem baaretz asher lo-chillum bene yisrael vayyaalem shelomo lemas ad hayyom hazze
Umin-bene yisrael asher lo-natan shelomo laavadim limlachto ki-hemma anshe milchama vesare shalishav vesare richbo ufarashav
Veelle sare hannitztzavim asher-lammelech shelomo chamishshim umatayim harodim baam
Veet-bat-paro heela shelomo meir david labbayit asher bana-lah ki amar lo-teshev ishsha li bevet david melech-yisrael ki-kodesh hemma asher-baa alehem aron Adonai
Az heela shelomo olot la-Adonai al mizbach Adonai asher bana lifne haulam
Uvidvar-yom beom lehaalot kemitzvat moshe lashshabbatot velechodashim velammoadot shalosh peamim bashshana bechag hammatztzot uvchag hashshavuot uvchag hassukkot

Vayyaamed kemishpat david-aviv et-machlekot hakkohanim al-avodatam vehalviyyim al-mishmerotam lehallel ulsharet neged hakkohanim lidvar-yom beomo vehashshoarim bemachlekotam leshaar vashaar ki chen mitzvat david ish-haelohim
Velo saru mitzvat hammelech al-hakkohanim vehalviyyim lechal-davar velaotzarot
Vattikkon kal-melechet shelomo ad-hayyom musad bet-Adonai vead-keloto shalem bet Adonai
Az halach shelomo leetzon-gever veel-elot al-sefat hayyam beeretz edom
Vayyishlach-lo churam beyad-avadav oniyyot vaavadim yode yam vayyavou im-avde shelomo ofira vayyikchu mishsham arba-meot vachamishshim kikkar zahav vayyaviu el-hammelech shelomo

Umalkat-sheva shama et-shema shelomo vattavo lenassot et-shelomo vechidot birushalam bechayil kaved meod ugmallim nosim besamim vezahav larov veeven yekara vattavo el-shelomo vattedabber immo et kal-asher haya im-levavah
Vayyagged-lah shelomo et-kal-devareha velo-nelam davar mishshelomo asher lo higgid lah
Vattere malkat-sheva et chachmat shelomo vehabbayit asher bana
Umaachal shulchano umoshav avadav umaamad meshartav umalbushehem umashkav umalbushehem vaaliyyato asher yaale bet Adonai velo-haya od bah ruach
Vattomer el-hammelech emet haddavar asher shamati beartzi al-devarecha veal-chachmatecha
Velo-heemanti ledivrehem ad asher-bati vattirena enay vehinne lo huggad-li chatzi marbit chachmatecha yasafta al-hashshemua asher shamati
Ashre anashecha veashre avadecha elle haomdim lefanecha tamid veshomim et-chachmatecha
Yehi Adonai elohecha baruch asher chafetz becha letittecha al-kiso lemelech la-Adonai elohecha beahavat elohecha et-yisrael lehaamido leolam vayyittencha alehem lemelech laasot mishpat utzdaka
Vattitten lammelech mea veesrim kikkar zahav uvsamim larov meod veeven yekara velo haya kabbosem hahu asher-natna malkat-sheva lammelech shelomo
Vegam-avde churam veavde shelomo asher-heviu zahav meofir heviu atze algummim veeven yekara
Vayyaas hammelech et-atze haalgummim mesillot levet-Adonai ulvet hammelech vechinnorot unvalim lashsharim velo-niru chahem lefanim beeretz yehuda
Vehammelech shelomo natan lemalkat-sheva et-kal-cheftzah asher shaala millevad asher-hevia el-hammelech vattahafoch vattelech leartzah hi vaavadeha
Vayehi mishkal hazzahav asher-ba lishlomo beshana echat shesh meot veshishshim vashesh kikkere zahav
Levad meanshe hattarim vehassocharim meviim vechal-malche arav ufachot haaretz meviim zahav vachesef lishlomo
Vayyaas hammelech shelomo matayim tzinna zahav shachut shesh meot zahav shachut yaale al-hatztzinna haechat
Ushlosh-meot maginnim zahav shachut shelosh meot zahav yaale al-hammagen haechat vayyittenem hammelech bevet yaar hallevanon
Vayyaas hammelech kisse-shen gadol vayetzappehu zahav tahor
Veshesh maalot lakkisse vechevesh bazzahav lakkisse maochazim veyadot mizze umizze al-mekom hashshavet ushnayim araot omdim etzel hayyadot
Ushnem asar araot omdim sham al-shesh hammaalot mizze umizze lo-naasa chen lechal-mamlacha
Vechol kele mashke hammelech shelomo zahav vechol kele bet-yaar hallevanon zahav sagur en kesef nechshav bime shelomo limuma
Ki-oniyyot lammelech holchot tarshish im avde churam achat leshalosh shanim tavona oniyyot tarshish nosot zahav vachesef shenhabbim vekofim vetukkiyyim
Vayyigdal hammelech shelomo mikkol malche haaretz leosher vechachma
Vechol malche haaretz mevakshim et-pene shelomo lishmoa et-chachmato asher-natan haelohim belibbo
Vehem meviim ish minchato kele chesef uchle zahav uslamot neshek uvsamim susim ufradim devar-shana beshana
Vayehi lishlomo arbaat alafim urot susim umarkavot ushnem-asar elef parashim vayyannichem beare harechev veim-hammelech birushalam
Vayehi moshel bechal-hammelachim min-hannahar vead-eretz pelishtim vead gevul mitzrayim
Vayyitten hammelech et-hakkesef birushalam kaavanim veet haarazim natan kashshikmim asher-bashshefela larov
Umotziim susim mimmitzrayim lishlomo umikkal-haaratzot
Ushar divre shelomo harishonim vehaacharonim halo-hem ketuvim al-divre natan hannavi veal-nevuat achiyya hashshiloni uvachazot yedo hachoze al-yaravam ben-nevat
Vayyimloch shelomo virushalam al-kal-yisrael arbaim shana
Vayyishkav shelomo im-avotav vayyikberuhu beir david aviv vayyimloch rechavam beno tachtav
Vayyelech rechavam shechema ki shechem bau chal-yisrael lehamlich oto
Vayehi kishmoa yaravam ben-nevat vehu vemitzrayim asher barach mippene shelomo hammelech vayyashav yaravam mimmitzrayim
Vayyishlechu vayyikreu-lo vayyavo yaravam vechal-yisrael vayedabberu el-rechavam lemor
Avicha hiksha et-ullenu veatta hakel meavodat avicha hakkasha umeullo hakkaved asher-natan alenu venaavdekka
Vayyomer alehem od sheloshet yamim veshuvu elay vayyelech haam
Vayyivaatz hammelech rechavam et-hazzekenim asher-hau omdim lifne shelomo aviv bihyoto chay lemor ech attem noatzim lehashiv laam-hazze davar
Vayedabberu elav lemor im-tihye letov lehaam hazze urtzitam vedibbarta alehem devarim tovim vehau lecha avadim kal-hayyamim
Vayyaazov et-atzat hazzekenim asher yeatzuhu vayyivaatz et-hayeladim asher gadlu itto haomdim lefanav
Vayyomer alehem ma attem noatzim venashiv davar et-haam hazze asher dibberu elay lemor hakel min-haol asher-natan avicha alenu
Vayedabberu itto hayeladim asher gadlu itto lemor ko-tomar laam asher-dibberu elecha lemor avicha hichbid et-ullenu veatta hakel mealenu ko tomar alehem katanni ava mimmatne avi
Veatta avi hemis alechem ol kaved vaani osif al-ullechem avi yissar etchem bashshotim vaani baakrabbim
Vayyavo yaravam vechal-haam el-rechavam bayyom hashshelishi kaasher dibber hammelech lemor shuvu elay bayyom hashshelishi
Vayyaanem hammelech kasha vayyaazov hammelech rechavam et atzat hazzekenim
Vayedabber alehem kaatzat hayeladim lemor achbid et-ullechem vaani osif alav avi yissar etchem bashshotim vaani baakrabbim
Velo-shama hammelech el-haam ki-hayeta nesibba meim haelohim lemaan hakim Adonai et-devaro asher dibber beyad achiyyahu hashshiloni el-yaravam ben-nevat

Vechal-yisrael ki lo-shama hammelech lahem vayyashivu haam et-hammelech lemor ma-lanu chelek bedavid velo-nachala beven-yishay ish leohalecha yisrael atta ree vetcha david vayyelech kal-yisrael leohalav
Uvne yisrael hayyoshvim beare yehuda vayyimloch alehem rechavam
Vayyishlach hammelech rechavam et-hadoram asher al-hammas vayyirgemu-vo vene-yisrael even vayyamot vehammelech rechavam hitammetz laalot bammerkava lanus yerushalam
Vayyifsheu yisrael bevet david ad hayyom hazze
Vayyavo rechavam yerushalam vayyakhel et-bet yehuda uvinyamin mea ushmonim elef bachur ose milchama lehillachem im-yisrael lehashiv et-hammamlacha lirchavam
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-shemayahu ish-haelohim lemor
Emor el-rechavam ben-shelomo melech yehuda veel kal-yisrael bihuda uvinyamin lemor
Ko amar Adonai lo-taalu velo-tillachamu im-achechem shuvu ish leveto ki meitti nihya haddavar hazze vayyishmeu et-divre Adonai vayyashuvu millechet el-yaravam
Vayyeshev rechavam birushalam vayyiven arim lematzor bihuda
Vayyiven et-bet-lechem veet-etam veet-tekoa
Veet-bet-tzur veet-socho veet-adullam
Veet-gat veet-maresha veet-zif
Veet-adorayim veet-lachish veet-azeka
Veet-tzara veet-ayyalon veet-chevron asher bihuda uvvinyamin are metzurot
Vayechazzek et-hammetzurot vayyitten bahem negidim veotzrot maachal veshemen vayayin
Uvchal-ir vair tzinnot urmachim vayechazzekem leharbe meod vayehi-lo yehuda uvinyamin
Vehakkohanim vehalviyyim asher bechal-yisrael hityatztzevu alav mikkal-gevulam
Ki-azvu halviyyim et-migreshehem vaachuzzatam vayyelchu lihuda velirushalam ki-hiznicham yaravam uvanav mikkahen la-Adonai
Vayyaamed-lo kohanim labbamot velasseirim velaagalim asher asa
Veacharehem mikkol shivte yisrael hannotnim et-levavam levakkesh et-Adonai elohe yisrael bau yerushalam lizboach la-Adonai elohe avotehem
Vayechazzeku et-malchut yehuda vayeammetzu et-rechavam ben-shelomo leshanim shalosh ki halchu bederech david ushlomo leshanim shalosh
Vayyikkach-lo rechavam ishsha et-machalat vn-bat- yerimot ben-david avihayil bat-eliav ben-yishay
Vatteled lo banim et-yeush veet-shemarya veet-zaham
Veachareha lakach et-maacha bat-avshalom vatteled lo et-aviyya veet-attay veet-ziza veet-shelomit
Vayyeehav rechavam et-maacha vat-avshalom mikkal-nashav ufilagshav ki nashim shemone-esre nasa ufilagshim shishshim vayyoled esrim ushmona banim veshishshim banot
Vayyaamed larosh rechavam et-aviyya ven-maacha lenagid beechav ki lehamlicho
Vayyaven vayyifrotz mikkal-banav lechal-artzot yehuda uvinyamin lechol are hammetzurot vayyitten lahem hammazon larov vayyishal hamon nashim
Vayehi kehachin malchut rechavam uchchezkato azav et-torat Adonai vechal-yisrael immo
Vayehi bashshana hachamishit lammelech rechavam ala shishak melech-mitzrayim al-yerushalam ki maalu ba-Adonai
Beelef umatayim rechev uvshishshim elef parashim veen mispar laam asher-bau immo mimmitzrayim luvim sukkiyyim vechushim
Vayyilkod et-are hammetzurot asher lihuda vayyavo ad-yerushalam
Ushmaya hannavi ba el-rechavam vesare yehuda asher-neesfu el-yerushalam mippene shishak vayyomer lahem ko-amar Adonai attem azavtem oti veaf-ani azavti etchem beyad-shishak
Vayyikkanu sare-yisrael vehammelech vayyomru tzaddik Adonai
Uvirot Adonai ki nichnau haya devar-Adonai el-shemaya lemor nichneu lo ashchitem venatatti lahem kimat lifleta velo-tittach chamati birushalam beyad-shishak
Ki yihu-lo laavadim veyedu avodati vaavodat mamlechot haaratzot
Vayyaal shishak melech-mitzrayim al-yerushalam vayyikkach et-otzrot bet-Adonai veet-otzrot bet hammelech et-hakkol lakach vayyikkach et-maginne hazzahav asher asa shelomo
Vayyaas hammelech rechavam tachtehem maginne nechoshet vehifkid al-yad sare haratzim hashshomrim petach bet hammelech
Vayehi midde-vo hammelech bet Adonai bau haratzim unsaum veheshivum el-ta haratzim
Uvhikkano shav mimmennu af-Adonai velo lehashchit lechala vegam bihuda haya devarim tovim

Vayyitchazzek hammelech rechavam birushalam vayyimloch ki ven-arbaim veachat shana rechavam bemalcho ushava esre shana malach birushalam hair asher-bachar Adonai lasum et-shemo sham mikkol shivte yisrael veshem immo naama haammonit
Vayyaas hara ki lo hechin libbo lidrosh et-Adonai
Vedivre rechavam harishonim vehaacharonim halo-hem ketuvim bedivre shemaya hannavi veiddo hachoze lehityaches umilchamot rechavam veyaravam kal-hayyamim
Vayyishkav rechavam im-avotav vayyikkaver beir david vayyimloch aviyya veno tachtav
Bishnat shemone esre lammelech yaravam vayyimloch aviyya al-yehuda
Shalosh shanim malach birushalam veshem immo michayahu vat-uriel min-giva umilchama hayeta ben aviyya uven yaravam
Vayyesor aviyya et-hammilchama bechayil gibbore milchama arba-meot elef ish bachur s veyaravam arach immo milchama bishmone meot elef ish bachur gibbor chayil
Vayyakam aviyya meal lehar tzemarayim asher behar efrayim vayyomer shemauni yaravam vechal-yisrael
Halo lachem ladaat ki Adonai elohe yisrael natan mamlacha ledavid al-yisrael leolam lo ulvanav berit melach
Vayyakam yaravam ben-nevat eved shelomo ven-david vayyimrod al-adonav
Vayyikkavtzu alav anashim rekim bene veliyyaal vayyitammetzu al-rechavam ben-shelomo urchavam haya naar verach-levav velo hitchazzak lifnehem
Veatta attem omrim lehitchazzek lifne mamlechet Adonai beyad bene david veattem hamon rav veimmachem egle zahav asher asa lachem yaravam lelohim
Halo hiddachtem et-kohane Adonai et-bene aharon vehalviyyim vattaasu lachem kohanim keamme haaratzot kal-habba lemalle yado befar ben-bakar veelim shiva vehaya chohen lelo elohim
Vaanachnu Adonai elohenu velo azavnuhu vechohanim meshartim la-Adonai bene aharon vehalviyyim bamlachet

Umaktirim la-Adonai olot babboker-babboker uvaerev-baerev uktoret-sammim umaarechet lechem al-hashshulchan hattahor umnorat hazzahav veneroteha levaer baerev baerev ki-shomrim anachnu et-mishmeret Adonai elohenu veattem azavtem oto
Vehinne immanu varosh haelohim vechohanav vachatzotzrot hatterua leharia alechem bene yisrael al-tillachamu im-Adonai elohe-avotechem ki-lo tatzlichu
Veyaravam hesev et-hammarav lavo meacharehem vayyihu lifne yehuda vehammarav meacharehem
Vayyifnu yehuda vehinne lahem hammilchama panim veachor vayyitzaku la-Adonai vehakkohanim machtzerim bachatzotzrot
Vayyariu ish yehuda vayehi beharia ish yehuda vehaelohim nagaf et-yaravam vechal-yisrael lifne aviyya vihuda
Vayyanusu vene-yisrael mippene yehuda vayyittenem elohim beyadam
Vayyakku vahem aviyya veammo makka rabba vayyippelu chalalim miyyisrael chamesh-meot elef ish bachur
Vayyikkanu vene-yisrael baet hahi vayyeemtzu bene yehuda ki nishanu al-Adonai elohe avotehem
Vayyirdof aviyya achare yaravam vayyilkod mimmennu arim et-bet-el veet-benoteha veet-yeshana veet-benoteha efrayin uvnoteha
Velo-atzar koach-yaravam od bime aviyyahu vayyiggefehu Adonai vayyamot
Vayyitchazzek aviyyahu vayyissa-lo nashim arba esre vayyoled esrim ushnayim banim veshesh esre banot
Veyeter divre aviyya udrachav udvarav ketuvim bemidrash hannavi iddo
Vayyishkav aviyya im-avotav vayyikberu oto beir david vayyimloch asa veno tachtav beyamav shakta haaretz eser shanim
Vayyaas asa hattov vehayyashar beene Adonai elohav
Vayyasar et-mizbechot hannechar vehabbamot vayeshabber et-hammatztzevot vayegadda et-haasherim
Vayyomer lihuda lidrosh et-Adonai elohe avotehem velaasot hattora vehammitzva
Vayyasar mikkal-are yehuda et-habbamot veet-hachammanim vattishkot hammamlacha lefanav
Vayyiven are metzura bihuda ki-shakta haaretz veen-immo milchama bashshanim haelle ki-heniach Adonai lo
Vayyomer lihuda nivne et-hearim haelle venasev choma umigdalim delatayim uvrichim odennu haaretz lefanenu ki darashnu et-Adonai elohenu darashnu vayyanach lanu missaviv vayyivnu vayyatzlichu
Vayehi leasa chayil nose tzinna varomach mihuda shelosh meot elef s umibbinyamin nose magen vedorche keshet matayim ushmonim alef kal-elle gibbore chayil
Vayyetze alehem zerach hakkushi bechayil elef alafim umarkavot shelosh meot vayyavo ad-maresha
Vayyetze asa lefanav vayyaarchu milchama bege tzefata lemaresha
Vayyikra asa el-Adonai elohav vayyomar Adonai en-immecha lazor ben rav leen koach azrenu Adonai elohenu ki-alecha nishannu uvshimcha vanu al-hehamon hazze Adonai elohenu atta al-yatzor immecha enosh
Vayyiggof Adonai et-hakkushim lifne asa velifne yehuda vayyanusu hakkushim
Vayyirdefem asa vehaam asher-immo ad-ligrar vayyippol mikkushim leen lahem michya ki-nishberu lifne-Adonai velifne machanehu vayyisu shalal harbe meod
Vayyakku et kal-hearim sevivot gerar ki-haya fachad-Adonai alehem vayyavozzu et-kal-hearim ki-vizza rabba hayeta vahem
Vegam-ahole mikne hikku vayyishbu tzon larov ugmallim vayyashuvu yerushalam
Vaazaryahu ben-oded hayeta alav ruach elohim
Vayyetze lifne asa vayyomer lo shemauni asa vechal-yehuda uvinyamin Adonai immachem bihotchem immo veim-tidreshuhu yimmatze lachem veim-taazvuhu yaazov etchem
Veyamim rabbim leyisrael lelo elohe emet ullo kohen more ullo tora
Vayyashav batztzar-lo al-Adonai elohe yisrael vayevakshuhu vayyimmatze lahem
Uvaittim hahem en shalom layyotze velabba ki mehumot rabbot al kal-yoshve haaratzot
Vechuttetu goy-begoy veir beir ki-elohim hamamam bechal-tzara
Veattem chizku veal-yirpu yedechem ki yesh sachar lifullatchem

Vechishmoa asa haddevarim haelle vehannevua oded hannavi hitchazzak vayyaaver hashshikkutzim mikkal-eretz yehuda uvinyamin umin-hearim asher lachad mehar efrayim vayechaddesh et-mizbach Adonai asher lifne ulam Adonai
Vayyikbotz et-kal-yehuda uvinyamin vehaggarim immahem meefrayim umnashshe umishshimon ki-naflu alav miyyisrael larov birotam ki-Adonai elohav immo
Vayyikkavtzu yerushalam bachodesh hashshelishi lishnat chamesh-esre lemalchut asa
Vayyizbechu la-Adonai bayyom hahu min-hashshalal heviu bakar sheva meot vetzon shivat alafim
Vayyavou vabberit lidrosh et-Adonai elohe avotehem bechal-levavam uvchal-nafsham
Vechol asher lo-yidrosh la-Adonai elohe-yisrael yumat lemin-katon vead-gadol lemeish vead-ishsha
Vayyishshavu la-Adonai bekol gadol uvitrua uvachatzotzrot uvshofarot
Vayyismechu chal-yehuda al-hashshevua ki vechal-levavam nishbau uvchal-retzonam bikshuhu vayyimmatze lahem vayyanach Adonai lahem missaviv
Vegam-maacha em asa hammelech hesirah miggevira asher-asta laashera miflatzet vayyichrot asa et-miflatztah vayyadek vayyisrof benachal kidron
Vehabbamot lo-saru miyyisrael rak levav-asa haya shalem kal-yamav
Vayyave et-kadshe aviv vekadashav bet haelohim kesef vezahav vechelim
Umilchama lo hayata ad shenat-sheloshim vechamesh lemalchut asa
Bishnat sheloshim vashesh lemalchut asa ala basha melech-yisrael al-yehuda vayyiven et-harama levilti tet yotze vava leasa melech yehuda
Vayyotze asa kesef vezahav meotzrot bet Adonai uvet hammelech vayyishlach el-ben-hadad melech aram hayyoshev bedarmesek lemor
Berit beni uvenecha uven avi uven avicha hinne shalachti lecha kesef vezahav lech hafer beritcha et-basha melech yisrael veyaale mealay
Vayyishma ben hadad el-hammelech asa vayyishlach et-sare hachayalim asher-lo el-are yisrael vayyakku et-iyyon veet-dan veet avel mayim veet kal-miskenot are naftali
Vayehi kishmoa basha vayyechdal mibbenot et-harama vayyashbet et-melachto
Veasa hammelech lakach et-kal-yehuda vayyisu et-avne harama veet-etzeha asher bana basha vayyiven bahem et-geva veet-hammitzpa
Uvaet hahi ba chanani haroe el-asa melech yehuda vayyomer elav behishshaencha al-melech aram velo nishanta al-Adonai elohecha al-ken nimlat chel melech-aram miyyadecha
Halo hakkushim vehalluvim hau lechayil larov lerechev ulfarashim leharbe meod uvhishshaencha al-Adonai netanam beyadecha
Ki Adonai enav meshottot bechal-haaretz lehitchazzek im-levavam shalem elav niskalta al-zot ki meatta yesh immecha milchamot
Vayyichas asa el-haroe vayyittenehu bet hammahpechet ki-vezaaf immo al-zot vayeratztzetz asa min-haam baet hahi
Vehinne divre asa harishonim vehaacharonim hinnam ketuvim al-sefer hammelachim lihuda veyisrael
Vayyechele asa bishnat sheloshim vatesha lemalchuto beraglav ad-lemala chalo vegam-bechalo lo-darash et-Adonai ki barofim
Vayyishkav asa im-avotav vayyamat bishnat arbaim veachat lemalcho
Vayyikberuhu vekivrotav asher kara-lo beir david vayyashkivuhu bammishkav asher mille besamim uznim merukkachim bemirkachat maase vayyisrefu-lo serefa gedola ad-limod
Vayyimloch yehoshafat beno tachtav vayyitchazzek al-yisrael
