Vayyitten-chayil bechal-are yehuda habbetzurot vayyitten netzivim beeretz yehuda uvare efrayim asher lachad asa aviv
Vayehi Adonai im-yehoshafat ki halach bedarche david aviv harishonim velo darash labbealim
Ki lelohe aviv darash uvmitzotav halach velo kemaase yisrael
Vayyachen Adonai et-hammamlacha beyado vayyittenu chal-yehuda mincha lihoshafat vayehi-lo osher-vechavod larov
Vayyigbah libbo bedarche Adonai veod hesir et-habbamot veet-haasherim mihuda
Uvishnat shalosh lemalcho shalach lesarav leven-chayil ulovadya velizcharya velintanel ulmichayahu lelammed beare yehuda
Veimmahem halviyyim shemayahu untanyahu uzvadyahu vaasahel ushmiramot vihonatan vaadoniyyahu vetoviyyahu vetov adoniyya halviyyim veimmahem elishama vihoram hakkohanim
Vayelammedu bihuda veimmahem sefer torat Adonai vayyasobbu bechal-are yehuda vayelammedu baam
Vayehi pachad Adonai al kal-mamlechot haaratzot asher sevivot yehuda velo nilchamu im-yehoshafat
Umin-pelishtim meviim lihoshafat mincha vechesef massa gam haarviim meviim lo tzon elim shivat alafim ushva meot utyashim shivat alafim ushva meot
Vayehi yehoshafat holech vegadel ad-lemala vayyiven bihuda biraniyyot veare miskenot
Umlacha rabba haya lo beare yehuda veanshe milchama gibbore chayil birushalam
Veelle fekuddatam levet avotehem lihuda sare alafim adna hassar veimmo gibbore chayil shelosh meot alef
Veal-yado yehochanan hassar veimmo matayim ushmonim alef
Veal-yado amasya ven-zichri hammitnaddev la-Adonai veimmo matayim elef gibbor chayil
Umin-binyamin gibbor chayil elyada veimmo noshke-keshet umagen matayim alef
Veal-yado yehozavad veimmo mea-ushmonim elef chalutze tzava
Elle hamshartim et-hammelech millevad asher-natan hammelech beare hammivtzar bechal-yehuda
Vayehi lihoshafat osher vechavod larov vayyitchatten leachav
Vayyered leketz shanim el-achav leshomron vayyizbach-lo achav tzon uvakar larov velaam asher immo vayesitehu laalot el-ramot gilad
Vayyomer achav melech-yisrael el-yehoshafat melech yehuda hatelech immi ramot gilad vayyomer lo kamoni chamocha uchammecha ammi veimmecha bammilchama
Vayyomer yehoshafat el-melech yisrael derash-na chayyom et-devar Adonai
Vayyikbotz melech-yisrael et-hanneviim arba meot ish vayyomer alehem hanelech el-ramot gilad lammilchama im-echdal vayyomru ale veyitten haelohim beyad hammelech
Vayyomer yehoshafat haen po navi la-Adonai od venidresha meoto

Vayyomer melech-yisrael el-yehoshafat od ish-echad lidrosh et-Adonai meoto vaani senetihu ki-enennu mitnabbe alay letova ki chal-yamav leraa hu michayehu ven-yimla vayyomer yehoshafat al-yomar hammelech ken
Vayyikra melech yisrael el-saris echad vayyomer maher michayehu ven-yimla
Umelech yisrael vihoshafat melech-yehuda yoshvim ish al-kiso melubbashim begadim veyoshvim begoren petach shaar shomron vechal-hanneviim mitnabbeim lifnehem
Vayyaas lo tzidkiyyahu ven-kenaana karne varzel vayyomer ko-amar Adonai beelle tenaggach et-aram ad-kallotam
Vechal-hanneviim nibbeim ken lemor ale ramot gilad vehatzlach venatan Adonai beyad hammelech
Vehammalach asher-halach likro lemichayehu dibber elav lemor hinne divre hanneviim pe-echad tov el-hammelech vihi-na devarcha keachad mehem vedibbarta tov
Vayyomer michayehu chay-Adonai ki et-asher-yomar elohay oto adabber
Vayyavo el-hammelech vayyomer hammelech elav micha hanelech el-ramot gilad lammilchama im-echdal vayyomer alu vehatzlichu veyinnatnu beyedchem
Vayyomer elav hammelech ad-kamme feamim ani mashbiecha asher lo-tedabber elay rak-emet beshem Adonai
Vayyomer raiti et-kal-yisrael nefotzim al-heharim katztzon asher en-lahen roe vayyomer Adonai lo-adonim laelle yashuvu ish-leveto beshalom
Vayyomer melech-yisrael el-yehoshafat halo amarti elecha lo-yitnabbe alay tov ki im-lera
Vayyomer lachen shimu devar-Adonai raiti et-Adonai yoshev al-kiso vechal-tzeva hashshamayim omdim al-yemino usmolo
Vayyomer Adonai mi yefatte et-achav melech-yisrael veyaal veyippol beramot gilad vayyomer ze omer kacha veze omer kacha
Vayyetze haruach vayyaamod lifne Adonai vayyomer ani afattennu vayyomer Adonai elav bamma
Vayyomer etze vehayiti leruach sheker befi kal-neviav vayyomer tefatte vegam-tuchal tze vaase-chen
Veatta hinne natan Adonai ruach sheker befi neviecha elle va-Adonai dibber alecha raa
Vayyiggash tzidkiyyahu ven-kenaana vayyach et-michayehu al-hallechi vayyomer e ze hadderech avar ruach-Adonai meitti ledabber otach
Vayyomer michayehu hinnecha roe bayyom hahu asher tavo cheder becheder lehechave
Vayyomer melech yisrael kechu et-michayehu vahashivuhu el-amon sar-hair veel-yoash ben-hammelech
Vaamartem ko amar hammelech simu ze bet hakkele vehaachiluhu lechem lachatz umayim lachatz ad shuvi veshalom
Vayyomer michayehu im-shov tashuv beshalom lo-dibber Adonai bi vayyomer shimu ammim kullam
Vayyaal melech-yisrael vihoshafat melech-yehuda el-ramot gilad
Vayyomer melech yisrael el-yehoshafat hitchappes vavo vammilchama veatta levash begadecha vayyitchappes melech yisrael vayyavou bammilchama
Umelech aram tziva et-sare harechev asher-lo lemor lo tillachamu et-hakkaton et-haggadol ki im-et-melech yisrael levaddo
Vayehi kirot sare harechev et-yehoshafat vehemma amru melech yisrael hu vayyasobbu alav lehillachem vayyizak yehoshafat va-Adonai azaro vayesitem elohim mimmennu
Vayehi kirot sare harechev ki lo-haya melech yisrael vayyashuvu meacharav
Veish mashach bakkeshet letummo vayyach et-melech yisrael ben haddevakim uven hashshiryan vayyomer larakkav hafoch yadcha vehotzetani min-hammachane ki hacholeti
Vattaal hammilchama bayyom hahu umelech yisrael haya maamid bammerkava nochach aram ad-haarev vayyamat leet bo hashshamesh
Vayyashav yehoshafat melech-yehuda el-beto beshalom lirushalam
Vayyetze el-panav yehu ven-chanani hachoze vayyomer el-hammelech yehoshafat halarasha lazor ulsone Adonai teehav uvazot alecha ketzef millifne Adonai
Aval devarim tovim nimtzeu immach ki-viarta haasherot min-haaretz vahachinota levavcha lidrosh haelohim
Vayyeshev yehoshafat birushalam s vayyashav vayyetze vaam mibbeer sheva ad-har efrayim vayeshivem el-Adonai elohe avotehem
Vayyaamed shoftim baaretz bechal-are yehuda habbetzurot leir vair
Vayyomer el-hashshoftim reu ma-attem osim ki lo leadam tishpetu ki la-Adonai veimmachem bidvar mishpat
Veatta yehi fachad-Adonai alechem shimru vaasu ki-en im-Adonai elohenu avela umasso fanim umikkach-shochad
Vegam birushalam heemid yehoshafat min-halviyyim vehakkohanim umerashe haavot leyisrael lemishpat Adonai velariv vayyashuvu yerushalam
Vayetzav alehem lemor ko taasun beyirat Adonai beemuna uvlevav shalem

Vechal-riv asher-yavo alechem meachechem hayyoshvim bearehem ben-dam ledam ben-tora lemitzva lechukkim ulmishpatim vehizhartem otam velo yeshemu la-Adonai vehaya-ketzef alechem veal-achechem ko taasun velo teshamu
Vehinne amaryahu chohen harosh alechem lechol devar-Adonai uzvadyahu ven-yishmael hannagid levet-yehuda lechol devar-hammelech veshotrim halviyyim lifnechem chizku vaasu vihi Adonai im-hattov
Vayehi acharechen bau vene-moav uvne ammon veimmahem mehaammonim al-yehoshafat lammilchama
Vayyavou vayyaggidu lihoshafat lemor ba alecha hamon rav meever layyam mearam vehinnam bechatztzon tamar hi en gedi
Vayyira vayyitten yehoshafat et-panav lidrosh la-Adonai vayyikra-tzom al-kal-yehuda
Vayyikkavtzu yehuda levakkesh me-Adonai gam mikkal-are yehuda bau levakkesh et-Adonai
Vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda virushalam bevet Adonai lifne hechatzer hachadasha
Vayyomar Adonai elohe avotenu halo atta-hu elohim bashshamayim veatta moshel bechol mamlechot haggoyim uvyadcha koach ugvura veen immecha lehityatztzev
Halo atta elohenu horashta et-yoshve haaretz hazzot millifne ammecha yisrael vattittenah lezera avraham ohavcha leolam
Vayyeshvu-vah vayyivnu lecha bah mikdash leshimcha lemor
Im-tavo alenu raa cherev shefot vedever veraav naamda lifne habbayit hazze ulfanecha ki shimcha babbayit hazze venizak elecha mitztzaratenu vetishma vetoshia
Veatta hinne vene-ammon umoav vehar-seir asher lo-natatta leyisrael lavo vahem bevoam meeretz mitzrayim ki saru mealehem velo hishmidum
Vehinne-hem gomlim alenu lavo legarshenu miyerushshatcha asher horashtanu
Elohenu halo tishpat-bam ki en banu koach lifne hehamon harav hazze habba alenu vaanachnu lo neda ma-naase ki alecha enenu
Vechal-yehuda omdim lifne Adonai gam-tappam neshehem uvnehem
Veyachaziel ben-zecharyahu ben-benaya ben-yeiel ben-mattanya hallevi min-bene asaf hayeta alav ruach Adonai betoch hakkahal
Vayyomer hakshivu chal-yehuda veyoshve yerushalam vehammelech yehoshafat ko-amar Adonai lachem attem al-tiru veal-techattu mippene hehamon harav hazze ki lo lachem hammilchama ki lelohim
Machar redu alehem hinnam olim bemaale hatztzitz umtzatem otam besof hannachal pene midbar yeruel
Lo lachem lehillachem bazot hityatztzevu imdu uru et-yeshuat Adonai immachem yehuda virushalam al-tiru veal-techattu machar tzeu lifnehem va-Adonai immachem
Vayyikkod yehoshafat appayim artza vechal-yehuda veyoshve yerushalam naflu lifne Adonai lehishtachaot la-Adonai
Vayyakumu halviyyim min-bene hakkehatim umin-bene hakkarchim lehallel la-Adonai elohe yisrael bekol gadol lemala
Vayyashkimu vabboker vayyetzu lemidbar tekoa uvtzetam amad yehoshafat vayyomer shemauni yehuda veyoshve yerushalam haaminu ba-Adonai elohechem veteamenu haaminu vinviav vehatzlichu
Vayyivaatz el-haam vayyaamed meshorarim la-Adonai umhallim lehadrat-kodesh betzet lifne hechalutz veomrim hodu la-Adonai ki leolam chasdo
Uvet hechellu verinna uthilla natan Adonai mearvim al-bene ammon moav vehar-seir habbaim lihuda vayyinnagefu
Vayyaamdu bene ammon umoav al-yoshve har-seir lehacharim ulhashmid uchchallotam beoshve seir azru ish-bereehu lemashchit
Vihuda ba al-hammitzpe lammidbar vayyifnu el-hehamon vehinnam pegarim noflim artza veen peleta
Vayyavo yehoshafat veammo lavoz et-shelalam vayyimtzeu vahem larov urchush ufgarim uchle chamudot vayenatztzelu lahem leen massa vayyihu yamim shelosha bozzim et-hashshalal ki rav-hu
Uvayyom harvii nikhalu leemek beracha ki-sham berachu et-Adonai al-ken karu et-shem hammakom hahu emek beracha ad-hayyom
Vayyashuvu kal-ish yehuda virushalam vihoshafat berosham lashuv el-yerushalam besimcha ki-simmecham Adonai meoyevehem
Vayyavou yerushalam binvalim uvchinnorot uvachatzotzrot el-bet Adonai
Vayehi pachad elohim al kal-mamlechot haaratzot beshamam ki nilcham Adonai im oyeve yisrael
Vattishkot malchut yehoshafat vayyanach lo elohav missaviv
Vayyimloch yehoshafat al-yehuda ben-sheloshim vechamesh shana bemalcho veesrim vechamesh shana malach birushalam veshem immo azuva bat-shilchi
Vayyelech bederech aviv asa velo-sar mimmenna laasot hayyashar beene Adonai
Ach habbamot lo-saru veod haam lo-hechinu levavam lelohe avotehem
Veyeter divre yehoshafat harishonim vehaacharonim hinnam ketuvim bedivre yehu ven-chanani asher hoala al-sefer malche yisrael
Veacharechen etchabbar yehoshafat melech-yehuda im achazya melech-yisrael hu hirshia laasot
Vayechabberehu immo laasot oniyyot lalechet tarshish vayyaasu oniyyot beetzon gaver
Vayyitnabbe eliezer ben-dodavahu mimmaresha al-yehoshafat lemor kehitchabbercha im-achazyahu paratz Adonai et-maasecha vayyishshavru oniyyot velo atzru lalechet el-tarshish
Vayyishkav yehoshafat im-avotav vayyikkaver im-avotav beir david vayyimloch yehoram beno tachtav
Velo-achim bene yehoshafat azarya vichiel uzcharyahu vaazaryahu umichael ushfatyahu kal-elle bene yehoshafat melech-yisrael
Vayyitten lahem avihem mattanot rabbot lechesef ulzahav ulmigdanot im-are metzurot bihuda veet-hammamlacha natan lihoram ki-hu habbechor
Vayyakam yehoram al-mamlechat aviv vayyitchazzak vayyaharog et-kal-echav becharev vegam missare yisrael
Ben-sheloshim ushtayim shana yehoram bemalcho ushmone shanim malach birushalam
Vayyelech bederech malche yisrael kaasher asu bet achav ki bat-achav hayeta lo ishsha vayyaas hara beene Adonai
Velo-ava Adonai lehashchit et-bet david lemaan habberit asher karat ledavid vechaasher amar latet lo nir ulvanav kal-hayyamim
Beyamav pasha edom mittachat yad-yehuda vayyamlichu alehem melech
Vayyaavor yehoram im-sarav vechal-harechev immo vayehi kam layela vayyach et-edom hassovev elav veet sare harachev
Vayyifsha edom mittachat yad-yehuda ad hayyom hazze az tifsha livna baet hahi mittachat yado ki azav et-Adonai elohe avotav
Gam-hu asa-vamot behare yehuda vayyezen et-yoshve yerushalam vayyaddach et-yehuda
Vayyavo elav michtav meeliyyahu hannavi lemor ko amar Adonai elohe david avicha tachat asher lo-halachta bedarche yehoshafat avicha uvdarche asa melech-yehuda
Vattelech bederech malche yisrael vattazne et-yehuda veet-yoshve yerushalam kehaznot bet achav vegam et-achecha vet-avicha hattovim mimmecha haragta
Hinne Adonai nogef maggefa gedola beammecha uvvanecha uvnashecha uvchal-rechushecha
Veatta bacholayim rabbim bemachale meecha ad-yetzu meecha min-hacholi yamim al-yamim
Vayyaar Adonai al-yehoram et ruach happelishtim vehaarvim asher al-yad kushim
Vayyaalu vihuda vayyivkauha vayyishbu et kal-harchush hannimtza levet-hammelech vegam-banav venashav velo nishar-lo ben ki im-yehoachaz keton banav
Veachare kal-zot negafo Adonai bemeav lacholi leen marpe
Vayehi leyamim miyyamim uchet tzet hakketz leyamim shenayim yatzu meav im-chalo vayyamat betachaluim raim velo-asu lo ammo serefa kisrefat avotav
Ben-sheloshim ushtayim haya vemalcho ushmone shanim malach birushalam vayyelech belo chemda vayyikberuhu beir david velo bekivrot hammelachim
Vayyamlichu yoshve yerushalam et-achazyahu veno hakkaton tachtav ki chal-harishonim harag haggedud habba vaarvim lammachane vayyimloch achazyahu ven-yehoram melech yehuda
Ben-arbaim ushtayim shana achazyahu vemalcho veshana achat malach birushalam veshem immo atalyahu bat-amri
Gam-hu halach bedarche bet achav ki immo hayeta yoatzto leharshia
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai kevet achav ki-hemma hau-lo yoatzim achare mot aviv lemashchit lo
Gam baatzatam halach vayyelech et-yehoram ben-achav melech yisrael lammilchama al-chazael melech-aram beramot gilad vayyakku harammim et-yoram
Vayyashav lehitrappe veyizreel ki hammakkim asher hikkuhu varama behillachamo et-chazahel melech aram vaazaryahu ven-yehoram melech yehuda yarad lirot et-yehoram ben-achav beyizreel ki-chole hu
Umeelohim hayeta tevusat achazyahu lavo el-yoram uvvoo yatza im-yehoram el-yehu ven-nimshi asher meshacho Adonai lehachrit et-bet achav
Vayehi kehishshafet yehu im-bet achav vayyimtza et-sare yehuda uvne ache achazyahu meshartim laachazyahu vayyahargem

Vayevakkesh et-achazyahu vayyilkeduhu vehu mitchabbe veshomron vayeviuhu el-yehu vayemituhu vayyikberuhu ki amru ben-yehoshafat hu asher-darash et-Adonai bechal-levavo veen levet achazyahu latzor koach lemamlacha
Vaatalyahu em achazyahu raata ki met benah vattakam vattedabber et-kal-zera hammamlacha levet yehuda

Vattikkach yehoshavat bat-hammelech et-yoash ben-achazyahu vattignov oto mittoch bene-hammelech hammumatim vattitten oto veet-menikto bachadar hammittot vattastirehu yehoshavat bat-hammelech yehoram eshet yehoyada hakkohen ki hi hayeta achot achazyahu mippene atalyahu velo hemitathu
Vayehi ittam bevet haelohim mitchabbe shesh shanim vaatalya molechet al-haaretz

Uvashshana hashsheviit hitchazzak yehoyada vayyikkach et-sare hammeot laazaryahu ven-yerocham ulyishmael ben-yehochanan velaazaryahu ven-oved veet-maaseyahu ven-adayahu veet-elishafat ben-zichri immo vabberit
Vayyasobbu bihuda vayyikbetzu et-halviyyim mikkal-are yehuda verashe haavot leyisrael vayyavou el-yerushalam
Vayyichrot kal-hakkahal berit bevet haelohim im-hammelech vayyomer lahem hinne ven-hammelech yimloch kaasher dibber Adonai al-bene david
Ze haddavar asher taasu hashshelishit mikkem bae hashshabbat lakkohanim velalviyyim leshoare hassippim
Vehashshelishit bevet hammelech vehashshelishit beshaar hayesod vechal-haam bechatzrot bet Adonai
Veal-yavo vet-Adonai ki im-hakkohanim vehamshartim lalviyyim hemma yavou ki-kodesh hemma vechal-haam yishmeru mishmeret Adonai
Vehikkifu halviyyim et-hammelech saviv ish vechelav beyado vehabba el-habbayit yumat vihu et-hammelech bevoo uvtzeto
Vayyaasu halviyyim vechal-yehuda kechol asher-tziva yehoyada hakkohen vayyikchu ish et-anashav bae hashshabbat im yotze hashshabbat ki lo fatar yehoyada hakkohen et-hammachlekot
Vayyitten yehoyada hakkohen lesare hammeot et-hachanitim veet-hammaginnot veet-hashshelatim asher lammelech david asher bet haelohim
Vayyaamed et-kal-haam veish shilcho veyado mikketef habbayit hayemanit ad-ketef habbayit hassemalit lammizbeach velabbayit al-hammelech saviv
Vayyotziu et-ben-hammelech vayyittenu alav et-hannezer veet-haedut vayyamlichu oto vayyimshachuhu yehoyada uvanav vayyomru yechi hammelech
Vattishma atalyahu et-kol haam haratzim vehamhallim et-hammelech vattavo el-haam bet Adonai

Vattere vehinne hammelech omed al-ammudo bammavo vehassarim vehachatzotzrot al-hammelech vechal-am haaretz sameach vetokea bachatzotzrot vehamshorarim bichle hashshir umodiim lehallel vattikra atalyahu et-begadeha vattomer kesher kasher
Vayyotze yehoyada hakkohen et-sare hammeot pekude hachayil vayyomer alehem hotziuha el-mibbet hassederot vehabba achareha yumat becharev ki amar hakkohen lo temituha bet Adonai
Vayyasimu lah yadayim vattavo el-mevo shaar-hassusim bet hammelech vayemituha sham
Vayyichrot yehoyada berit beno uven kal-haam uven hammelech lihot leam la-Adonai
Vayyavou chal-haam bet-habbaal vayyittetzuhu veet-mizbechotav veet-tzelamav shibberu veet mattan kohen habbaal hargu lifne hammizbechot
Vayyasem yehoyada pekuddot bet Adonai beyad hakkohanim halviyyim asher chalak david al-bet Adonai lehaalot olot Adonai kakkatuv betorat moshe besimcha uvshir al yede david
Vayyaamed hashshoarim al-shaare bet Adonai velo-yavo tame lechal-davar

Vayyikkach et-sare hammeot veet-haaddirim veet-hammoshlim baam veet kal-am haaretz vayyored et-hammelech mibbet Adonai vayyavou betoch-shaar haelon bet hammelech vayyoshivu et-hammelech al kisse hammamlacha
Vayyismechu chal-am-haaretz vehair shakata veet-atalyahu hemitu vecharev
Ben-sheva shanim yoash bemalcho vearbaim shana malach birushalam veshem immo tzivya mibbeer shava
Vayyaas yoash hayyashar beene Adonai kal-yeme yehoyada hakkohen
Vayyissa-lo yehoyada nashim shettayim vayyoled banim uvanot
Vayehi acharechen haya im-lev yoash lechaddesh et-bet Adonai
Vayyikbotz et-hakkohanim vehalviyyim vayyomer lahem tzeu leare yehuda vekivtzu mikkal-yisrael kesef lechazzek et-bet elohechem midde shana beshana veattem temaharu laddavar velo miharu halviyyim
Vayyikra hammelech lihoyada harosh vayyomer lo maddua lo-darashta al-halviyyim lehavi mihuda umirushalam et-masat moshe eved-Adonai vehakkahal leyisrael leohel haedut
Ki atalyahu hammirshaat baneha fartzu et-bet haelohim vegam kal-kadshe vet-Adonai asu labbealim
Vayyomer hammelech vayyaasu aron echad vayyittenuhu beshaar bet-Adonai chutza
Vayyittenu-kol bihuda uvirushalam lehavi la-Adonai masat moshe eved-haelohim al-yisrael bammidbar
Vayyismechu chal-hassarim vechal-haam vayyaviu vayyashlichu laaron ad-lechalle

Vayehi beet yavi et-haaron el-pekuddat hammelech beyad halviyyim vechirotam ki-rav hakkesef uva sofer hammelech ufkid kohen harosh viaru et-haaron veyissauhu vishivuhu el-mekomo ko asu leom beom vayyaasfu-chesef larov
Vayyittenehu hammelech vihoyada el-ose melechet avodat bet-Adonai vayyihu sochrim chotzvim vecharashim lechaddesh bet Adonai vegam lecharashe varzel unchoshet lechazzek et-bet Adonai
Vayyaasu ose hammelacha vattaal arucha lammelacha beyadam vayyaamidu et-bet haelohim al-matkunto vayeammetzuhu

Uchchallotam heviu lifne hammelech vihoyada et-shear hakkesef vayyaasehu chelim levet-Adonai kele sharet vehaalot vechappot uchle zahav vachasef vayyihu maalim olot bevet-Adonai tamid kol yeme yehoyada
Vayyizkan yehoyada vayyisba yamim vayyamot ben-mea ushloshim shana bemoto
Vayyikberuhu veir-david im-hammelachim ki-asa tova beyisrael veim haelohim uveto
Veachare mot yehoyada bau sare yehuda vayyishtachau lammelech az shama hammelech alehem
Vayyaazvu et-bet Adonai elohe avotehem vayyaavdu et-haasherim veet-haatzabbim vayehi-ketzef al-yehuda virushalam beashmatam zot
Vayyishlach bahem neviim lahashivam el-Adonai vayyaidu vam velo heezinu
Veruach elohim lavsha et-zecharya ben-yehoyada hakkohen vayyaamod meal laam vayyomer lahem ko amar haelohim lama attem ovrim et-mitzot Adonai velo tatzlichu ki-azavtem et-Adonai vayyaazov etchem
Vayyiksheru alav vayyirgemuhu even bemitzvat hammelech bachatzar bet Adonai
Velo-zachar yoash hammelech hachesed asher asa yehoyada aviv immo vayyaharog et-beno uchmoto amar yere Adonai veyidrosh
Vayehi litkufat hashshana ala alav chel aram vayyavou el-yehuda virushalam vayyashchitu et-kal-sare haam meam vechal-shelalam shillechu lemelech darmasek
Ki vemitzar anashim bau chel aram va-Adonai natan beyadam chayil larov meod ki azvu et-Adonai elohe avotehem veet-yoash asu shefatim
Uvlechtam mimmennu ki-azvu oto bemachaluyim rabbim hitkashsheru alav avadav bidme bene yehoyada hakkohen vayyaharguhu al-mittato vayyamot vayyikberuhu beir david velo kevaruhu bekivrot hammelachim
Veelle hammitkashsherim alav zavad ben-shimat haammonit vihozavad ben-shimrit hammoavit
Uvanav yirev hammassa alav visod bet haelohim hinnam ketuvim al-midrash sefer hammelachim vayyimloch amatzyahu veno tachtav
Ben-esrim vechamesh shana malach amatzyahu veesrim vatesha shana malach birushalam veshem immo yehoaddan mirushalayim
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai rak lo belevav shalem
Vayehi kaasher chazka hammamlacha alav vayyaharog et-avadav hammakkim et-hammelech aviv
Veet-benehem lo hemit ki chakkatuv battora besefer moshe asher-tziva Adonai lemor lo-yamutu avot al-banim uvanim lo-yamutu al-avot ki ish becheto yamutu

Vayyikbotz amatzyahu et-yehuda vayyaamidem levet-avot lesare haalafim ulsare hammeot lechal-yehuda uvinyamin vayyifkedem lemibben esrim shana vamala vayyimtzaem shelosh-meot elef bachur yotze tzava ochez romach vetzinna
Vayyiskor miyyisrael mea elef gibbor chayil bemea chikkar-kasef
Veish haelohim ba elav lemor hammelech al-yavo immecha tzeva yisrael ki en Adonai im-yisrael kol bene efrayim
Ki im-bo atta ase chazak lammilchama yachshilcha haelohim lifne oyev ki yesh-koach belohim lazor ulhachshil
Vayyomer amatzyahu leish haelohim uma-laasot limat hakkikkar asher natatti ligdud yisrael vayyomer ish haelohim yesh la-Adonai latet lecha harbe mizze
Vayyavdilem amatzyahu lehaggedud asher-ba elav meefrayim lalechet limkomam vayyichar appam meod bihuda vayyashuvu limkomam bachori-af
Vaamatzyahu hitchazzak vayyinhag et-ammo vayyelech ge hammelach vayyach et-bene-seir aseret alafim
Vaaseret alafim chayyim shavu bene yehuda vayevium lerosh hassala vayyashlichum merosh-hassela vechullam nivkau
Uvne haggedud asher heshiv amatzyahu millechet immo lammilchama vayyifshetu beare yehuda mishshomron vead-bet choron vayyakku mehem sheloshet alafim vayyavozzu bizza rabba
Vayehi achare vo amatzyahu mehakkot et-adomim vayyave et-elohe bene seir vayyaamidem lo lelohim velifnehem yishtachave velahem yekatter
Vayyichar-af Adonai baamatzyahu vayyishlach elav navi vayyomer lo lamma darashta et-elohe haam asher lo-hitztzilu et-ammam miyyadecha
Vayehi bedabbero elav vayyomer lo haloetz lammelech netannucha chadal-lecha lamma yakkucha vayyechdal hannavi vayyomer yadati ki-yaatz elohim lehashchitecha ki-asita zot velo shamata laatzati
Vayyivaatz amatzyahu melech yehuda vayyishlach el-yoash ben-yehoachaz ben-yehu melech yisrael lemor lecha nitrae fanim

Vayyishlach yoash melech-yisrael el-amatzyahu melech-yehuda lemor hachoach asher ballevanon shalach el-haerez asher ballevanon lemor tena-et-bittecha livni leishsha vattaavor chayyat hassade asher ballevanon vattirmos et-hachoach
Amarta hinne hikkita et-edom unsaacha libbecha lehachbid atta sheva bevetecha lamma titgare beraa venafalta atta vihuda immach
Velo-shama amatzyahu ki mehaelohim hi lemaan tittam beyad ki darshu et elohe edom
Vayyaal yoash melech-yisrael vayyitrau fanim hu vaamatzyahu melech-yehuda bevet shemesh asher lihuda
Vayyinnagef yehuda lifne yisrael vayyanusu ish leohalav
Veet amatzyahu melech-yehuda ben-yoash ben-yehoachaz tafas yoash melech-yisrael bevet shamesh vayeviehu yerushalam vayyifrotz bechomat yerushalam mishshaar efrayim ad-shaar happone arba meot amma
Vechal-hazzahav vehakkesef veet kal-hakkelim hannimtzeim bevet-haelohim im-oved edom veet-otzrot bet hammelech veet bene hattaaruvot vayyashav shomron
Vayechi amatzyahu ven-yoash melech yehuda achare mot yoash ben-yehoachaz melech yisrael chamesh esre shana
Veyeter divre amatzyahu harishonim vehaacharonim halo hinnam ketuvim al-sefer malche-yehuda veyisrael
Umeet asher-sar amatzyahu meachare Adonai vayyiksheru alav kesher birushalam vayyanas lachisha vayyishlechu acharav lachisha vayemituhu sham
Vayyissauhu al-hassusim vayyikberu oto im-avotav beir yehuda
Vayyikchu kal-am yehuda et-uzziyyahu vehu ben-shesh esre shana vayyamlichu oto tachat aviv amatzyahu
Hu bana et-elot vayeshiveha lihuda achare shechav-hammelech im-avotav
Ben-shesh esre shana uzziyyahu vemalcho vachamishshim ushtayim shana malach birushalam veshem immo yechalya min-yerushalam
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai kechol asher-asa amatzyahu aviv
Vayehi lidrosh elohim bime zecharyahu hammevin birot haelohim uvime darsho et-Adonai hitzlicho haelohim
Vayyetze vayyillachem bappelishtim vayyifrotz et-chomat gat veet chomat yavne veet chomat ashdod vayyivne arim beashdod uvappelishtim
Vayyazerehu haelohim al-pelishtim haarvim hayyoshvim begur-baal vehammeunim
Vayyittenu haammonim mincha leuzziyyahu vayyelech shemo ad-levo mitzrayim ki hechezik ad-lemala
Vayyiven uzziyyahu migdalim birushalam al-shaar happinna veal-shaar haggaye veal-hammiktzoa vayechazzekem
Vayyiven migdalim bammidbar vayyachtzov borot rabbim ki mikne-rav haya lo uvashshefela uvammishor ikkarim vechormim beharim uvakkarmel ki-ohev adama haya
Vayehi leuzziyyahu chayil ose milchama yotze tzava ligdud bemispar pekuddatam beyad yeiel hassofer umaaseyahu hashshoter al yad-chananyahu missare hammelech
Kol mispar rashe haavot legibbore chayil alpayim veshesh meot
Veal-yadam chel tzava shelosh meot elef veshivat alafim vachamesh meot ose milchama bechoach chayil lazor lammelech al-haoyev
Vayyachen lahem uzziyyahu lechal-hatztzava maginnim urmachim vechovaim veshiryonot ukshatot ulavne kelaim
Vayyaas birushalam chishshevonot machashevet choshev lihot al-hammigdalim veal-happinnot liro bachitztzim uvaavanim gedolot vayyetze shemo ad-lemerachok ki-hifli leheazer ad ki-chazak
Uchchezkato gavah libbo ad-lehashchit vayyimal ba-Adonai elohav vayyavo el-hechal Adonai lehaktir al-mizbach hakketoret
Vayyavo acharav azaryahu hakkohen veimmo kohanim la-Adonai shemonim bene-chayil
Vayyaamdu al-uzziyyahu hammelech vayyomru lo lo-lecha uzziyyahu lehaktir la-Adonai ki lakkohanim bene-aharon hamkuddashim lehaktir tze min-hammikdash ki maalta velo-lecha lechavod me-Adonai elohim
Vayyizaf uzziyyahu uvyado mikteret lehaktir uvzapo im-hakkohanim vehatztzaraat zarcha vemitzcho lifne hakkohanim bevet Adonai meal lemizbach hakketoret
Vayyifen elav azaryahu chohen harosh vechal-hakkohanim vehinne-hu metzora bemitzcho vayyavhiluhu mishsham vegam-hu nidchaf latzet ki niggeo Adonai
Vayehi uzziyyahu hammelech metzora ad-yom moto vayyeshev bet hachafshit metzora ki nigzar mibbet Adonai veotam beno al-bet hammelech shofet et-am haaretz
Veyeter divre uzziyyahu harishonim vehaacharonim katav yeshayahu ven-amotz hannavi
Vayyishkav uzziyyahu im-avotav vayyikberu oto im-avotav bisde hakkevura asher lammelachim ki amru metzora hu vayyimloch yotam beno tachtav
Ben-esrim vechamesh shana yotam bemalcho veshesh-esre shana malach birushalam veshem immo yerusha bat-tzadok
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai kechol asher-asa uzziyyahu aviv rak lo-va el-hechal Adonai veod haam mashchitim
Hu bana et-shaar bet-Adonai haelon uvchomat haofel bana larov
Vearim bana behar-yehuda uvechorashim bana biraniyyot umigdalim

Vehu nilcham im-melech bene-ammon vayyechezak alehem vayyittenu-lo vene-ammon bashshana hahi mea kikkar-kesef vaaseret alafim korim chittim usorim aseret alafim zot heshivu lo bene ammon s uvashshana hashshenit vehashshelishit
Vayyitchazzek yotam ki hechin derachav lifne Adonai elohav
Veyeter divre yotam vechal-milchamotav udrachav hinnam ketuvim al-sefer malche-yisrael vihuda
Ben-esrim vechamesh shana haya vemalcho veshesh-esre shana malach birushalam
Vayyishkav yotam im-avotav vayyikberu oto beir david vayyimloch achaz beno tachtav
Ben-esrim shana achaz bemalcho veshesh-esre shana malach birushalam velo-asa hayyashar beene Adonai kedavid aviv
Vayyelech bedarche malche yisrael vegam massechot asa labbealim
Vehu hiktir bege ven-hinnom vayyaver et-banav baesh ketoavot haggoyim asher horish Adonai mippene bene yisrael
Vayezabbeach vayekatter babbamot veal-haggevaot vetachat kal-etz raanan
Vayyittenehu Adonai elohav beyad melech aram vayyakku-vo vayyishbu mimmennu shivya gedola vayyaviu darmasek vegam beyad-melech yisrael nittan vayyach-bo makka gedola
Vayyaharog pekach ben-remalyahu bihuda mea veesrim elef beom echad hakkol bene-chayil beazvam et-Adonai elohe avotam
Vayyaharog zichri gibbor efrayim et-maaseyahu ben-hammelech veet-azrikam negid habbayit veet-elkana mishne hammelech
Vayyishbu vene-yisrael meachehem matayim elef nashim banim uvanot vegam-shalal rav bazzu mehem vayyaviu et-hashshalal leshomron

Vesham haya navi la-Adonai oded shemo vayyetze lifne hatztzava habba leshomron vayyomer lahem hinne bachamat Adonai elohe-avotechem al-yehuda netanam beyedchem vattahargu-vam vezaaf ad lashshamayim higgia
Veatta bene-yehuda virushalam attem omrim lichbosh laavadim velishfachot lachem halo rak-attem immachem ashamot la-Adonai elohechem
Veatta shemauni vehashivu hashshivya asher shevitem meachechem ki charon af-Adonai alechem
Vayyakumu anashim merashe vene-efrayim azaryahu ven-yehochanan berechyahu ven-meshillemot vichizkiyyahu ben-shallum vaamasa ben-chadlay al-habbaim min-hatztzava
Vayyomru lahem lo-taviu et-hashshivya henna ki leashmat Adonai alenu attem omrim lehosif al-chattotenu veal-ashmatenu ki-rabba ashma lanu vacharon af al-yisrael
Vayyaazov hechalutz et-hashshivya veet-habbizza lifne hassarim vechal-hakkahal

Vayyakumu haanashim asher-nikkevu veshemot vayyachaziku vashshivya vechal-maarummehem hilbishu min-hashshalal vayyalbishum vayyanilum vayyaachilum vayyashkum vayesuchum vayenahalum bachamorim lechal-koshel vayevium yerecho ir-hattemarim etzel achehem vayyashuvu shomron
Baet hahi shalach hammelech achaz al-malche ashshur lazor lo
Veod adomim bau vayyakku vihuda vayyishbu-shevi
Uflishtim pashtu beare hashshefela vehannegev lihuda vayyilkedu et-bet-shemesh veet-ayyalon veet-haggederot veet-socho uvnoteha veet-timna uvnoteha veet-gimzo veet-benoteha vayyeshvu sham
Ki-hichnia Adonai et-yehuda baavur achaz melech-yisrael ki hifria bihuda umaol maal ba-Adonai
Vayyavo alav tillegat pilneeser melech ashshur vayyatzar lo velo chazako
Ki-chalak achaz et-bet Adonai veet-bet hammelech vehassarim vayyitten lemelech ashshur velo leezra lo
Uvet hatzer lo vayyosef limol ba-Adonai hu hammelech achaz
Vayyizbach lelohe darmesek hammakkim bo vayyomer ki elohe malche-aram hem mazerim otam lahem azabbeach veyazeruni vehem hau-lo lehachshilo ulchal-yisrael
Vayyeesof achaz et-kele vet-haelohim vayekatztzetz et-kele vet-haelohim vayyisgor et-daltot bet-Adonai vayyaas lo mizbechot bechal-pinna birushalam
Uvchal-ir vair lihuda asa vamot lekatter lelohim acherim vayyaches et-Adonai elohe avotav
Veyeter devarav vechal-derachav harishonim vehaacharonim hinnam ketuvim al-sefer malche-yehuda veyisrael
Vayyishkav achaz im-avotav vayyikberuhu vair birushalam ki lo heviuhu lekivre malche yisrael vayyimloch yechizkiyyahu veno tachtav
Yechizkiyyahu malach ben-esrim vechamesh shana veesrim vatesha shana malach birushalam veshem immo aviyya bat-zecharyahu
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai kechol asher-asa david aviv
Hu vashshana harishona lemalcho bachodesh harishon patach et-daltot bet-Adonai vayechazzekem
Vayyave et-hakkohanim veet-halviyyim vayyaasfem lirchov hammizrach
Vayyomer lahem shemauni halviyyim atta hitkaddeshu vekaddeshu et-bet Adonai elohe avotechem vehotziu et-hannidda min-hakkodesh
Ki-maalu avotenu veasu hara beene Adonai-elohenu vayyaazvuhu vayyassebbu fenehem mimmishkan Adonai vayyittenu-oref
Gam sagru daltot haulam vayechabbu et-hannerot uktoret lo hiktiru veola lo-heelu vakkodesh lelohe yisrael
Vayehi ketzef Adonai al-yehuda virushalam vayyittenem lezaava leshamma velishreka kaasher attem roim beenechem
Vehinne naflu avotenu becharev uvanenu uvnotenu venashenu bashshevi al-zot
Atta im-levavi lichrot berit la-Adonai elohe yisrael veyashov mimmennu charon appo
Banay atta al-tishshalu ki-vachem bachar Adonai laamod lefanav lesharto velihot lo meshartim umaktirim
Vayyakumu halviyyim machat ben-amasay veoel ben-azaryahu min-bene hakkehati umin-bene merari kish ben-avdi vaazaryahu ben-yehallelel umin-haggershunni yoach ben-zimma veeden ben-yoach
Umin-bene elitzafan shimri viiel umin-bene asaf zecharyahu umattanyahu
Umin-bene heman yechiel veshimi s umin-bene yedutun shemaya veuzziel
Vayyaasfu et-achehem vayyitkaddeshu vayyavou chemitzvat-hammelech bedivre Adonai letaher bet Adonai
Vayyavou hakkohanim lifnima vet-Adonai letaher vayyotziu et kal-hattuma asher matzu behechal Adonai lachatzar bet Adonai vayekabbelu halviyyim lehotzi lenachal-kidron chutza
Vayyachellu beechad lachodesh harishon lekaddesh uvom shemona lachodesh bau leulam Adonai vayekaddeshu et-bet-Adonai leyamim shemona uvom shishsha asar lachodesh harishon killu
Vayyavou fenima el-chizkiyyahu hammelech vayyomru tiharnu et-kal-bet Adonai et-mizbach haola veet-kal-kelav veet-shulchan hammaarechet veet-kal-kelav
Veet kal-hakkelim asher hizniach hammelech achaz bemalchuto bemaalo hechannu vehikdashnu vehinnam lifne mizbach Adonai
Vayyashkem yechizkiyyahu hammelech vayyeesof et sare hair vayyaal bet Adonai
Vayyaviu farim-shiva veelim shiva uchvasim shiva utzfire izzim shiva lechattat al-hammamlacha veal-hammikdash veal-yehuda vayyomer livne aharon hakkohanim lehaalot al-mizbach Adonai
Vayyishchatu habbakar vayekabbelu hakkohanim et-haddam vayyizreku hammizbecha vayyishchatu haelim vayyizreku haddam hammizbecha vayyishchatu hakkevasim vayyizreku haddam hammizbecha
Vayyaggishu et-seire hachattat lifne hammelech vehakkahal vayyismechu yedehem alehem
Vayyishchatum hakkohanim vayechatteu et-damam hammizbecha lechapper al-kal-yisrael ki lechal-yisrael amar hammelech haola vehachattat
Vayyaamed et-halviyyim bet Adonai bimtziltayim binvalim uvchinnorot bemitzvat david vegad choze-hammelech venatan hannavi ki veyad-Adonai hammitzva beyad-neviav
Vayyaamdu halviyyim bichle david vehakkohanim bachatzotzrot
Vayyomer chizkiyyahu lehaalot haola lehammizbeach uvet hechel haola hechel shir-Adonai vehachatzotzrot veal-yede kele david melech-yisrael
Vechal-hakkahal mishtachavim vehashshir meshorer vehachatzotzrot machtzerim hakkol ad lichlot haola
Uchchallot lehaalot karu hammelech vechal-hannimtzeim itto vayyishtachau
Vayyomer yechizkiyyahu hammelech vehassarim lalviyyim lehallel la-Adonai bedivre david veasaf hachoze vayehallu ad-lesimcha vayyikkedu vayyishtachau
Vayyaan yechizkiyyahu vayyomer atta milletem yedchem la-Adonai goshu vehaviu zevachim vetodot levet Adonai vayyaviu hakkahal zevachim vetodot vechal-nediv lev olot
Vayehi mispar haola asher heviu hakkahal bakar shivim elim mea kevasim matayim leola la-Adonai kal-elle
Vehakkodashim bakar shesh meot vetzon sheloshet alafim
Rak hakkohanim hau limat velo yachlu lehafshit et-kal-haolot vayechazzekum achehem halviyyim ad-kelot hammelacha vead yitkaddeshu hakkohanim ki halviyyim yishre levav lehitkaddesh mehakkohanim
Vegam-ola larov bechelve hashshelamim uvannesachim laola vattikkon avodat bet-Adonai
Vayyismach yechizkiyyahu vechal-haam al hahechin haelohim laam ki befitom haya haddavar
Vayyishlach yechizkiyyahu al-kal-yisrael vihuda vegam-iggerot katav al-efrayim umnashshe lavo levet-Adonai birushalam laasot pesach la-Adonai elohe yisrael
Vayyivaatz hammelech vesarav vechal-hakkahal birushalam laasot happesach bachodesh hashsheni
Ki lo yachlu laasoto baet hahi ki hakkohanim lo-hitkaddeshu lemadday vehaam lo-neesfu lirushalam
Vayyishar haddavar beene hammelech uvene kal-hakkahal
Vayyaamidu davar lehaavir kol bechal-yisrael mibbeer-sheva vead-dan lavo laasot pesach la-Adonai elohe-yisrael birushalam ki lo larov asu kakkatuv

Vayyelchu haratzim baiggerot miyyad hammelech vesarav bechal-yisrael vihuda uchmitzvat hammelech lemor bene yisrael shuvu el-Adonai elohe avraham yitzchak veyisrael veyashov el-happeleta hannisheret lachem mikkaf malche ashshur
Veal-tihu kaavotechem vechaachechem asher maalu ba-Adonai elohe avotehem vayyittenem leshamma kaasher attem roim
Atta al-takshu arpechem kaavotechem tenu-yad la-Adonai uvou lemikdasho asher hikdish leolam veivdu et-Adonai elohechem veyashov mikkem charon appo
Ki veshuvchem al-Adonai achechem uvnechem lerachamim lifne shovehem velashuv laaretz hazzot ki-channun verachum Adonai elohechem velo-yasir panim mikkem im-tashuvu elav
Vayyihu haratzim ovrim meir lair beeretz-efrayim umnashshe vead-zevulun vayyihu maschikim alehem umaligim bam
Ach-anashim measher umnashshe umizzevulun nichneu vayyavou lirushalam
Gam bihuda hayeta yad haelohim latet lahem lev echad laasot mitzvat hammelech vehassarim bidvar Adonai
Vayyeasfu yerushalam am-rav laasot et-chag hammatztzot bachodesh hashsheni kahal larov meod
Vayyakumu vayyasiru et-hammizbechot asher birushalam veet kal-hamkatterot hesiru vayyashlichu lenachal kidron
Vayyishchatu happesach bearbaa asar lachodesh hashsheni vehakkohanim vehalviyyim nichlemu vayyitkaddeshu vayyaviu olot bet Adonai
Vayyaamdu al-amdam kemishpatam ketorat moshe ish-haelohim hakkohanim zorkim et-haddam miyyad halviyyim
Ki-rabbat bakkahal asher lo-hitkaddashu vehalviyyim al-shechitat happesachim lechol lo tahor lehakdish la-Adonai
Ki marbit haam rabbat meefrayim umnashshe yissashchar uzvulun lo hitteharu ki-achlu et-happesach belo chakkatuv ki hitpallel yechizkiyyahu alehem lemor Adonai hattov yechapper bead
Kal-levavo hechin lidrosh haelohim Adonai elohe avotav velo ketahorat hakkodesh
Vayyishma Adonai el-yechizkiyyahu vayyirpa et-haam
Vayyaasu vene-yisrael hannimtzeim birushalam et-chag hammatztzot shivat yamim besimcha gedola umhallim la-Adonai yom beom halviyyim vehakkohanim bichle-oz la-Adonai
Vayedabber yechizkiyyahu al-lev kal-halviyyim hammaskilim sechel-tov la-Adonai vayyochlu et-hammoed shivat hayyamim mezabbechim zivche shelamim umitvaddim la-Adonai elohe avotehem
Vayyivaatzu kal-hakkahal laasot shivat yamim acherim vayyaasu shivat-yamim simcha
Ki chizkiyyahu melech-yehuda herim lakkahal elef parim veshivat alafim tzon s vehassarim herimu lakkahal parim elef vetzon aseret alafim vayyitkaddeshu chohanim larov
Vayyismechu kal-kehal yehuda vehakkohanim vehalviyyim vechal-hakkahal habbaim miyyisrael vehaggerim habbaim meeretz yisrael vehayyoshvim bihuda
Vattehi simcha-gedola birushalam ki mime shelomo ven-david melech yisrael lo chazot birushalam
Vayyakumu hakkohanim halviyyim vayevarachu et-haam vayyishshama bekolam vattavo tefillatam limon kadsho lashshamayim

Uchchallot kal-zot yatzu kal-yisrael hannimtzeim leare yehuda vayeshabberu hammatztzevot vayegaddeu haasherim vayenattetzu et-habbamot veet-hammizbechot mikkal-yehuda uvinyamin uvefrayim umnashshe ad-lechalle vayyashuvu kal-bene yisrael ish laachuzzato learehem
Vayyaamed yechizkiyyahu et-machlekot hakkohanim vehalviyyim al-machlekotam ish kefi avodato lakkohanim velalviyyim leola velishlamim lesharet ulhodot ulhallel beshaare machanot Adonai
Umnat hammelech min-rechusho laolot leolot habboker vehaerev vehaolot lashshabbatot velechodashim velammoadim kakkatuv betorat Adonai
Vayyomer laam leoshve yerushalam latet menat hakkohanim vehalviyyim lemaan yechezku betorat Adonai
Vechifrotz haddavar hirbu vene-yisrael reshit dagan tirosh veyitzhar udvash vechol tevuat sade umasar hakkol larov heviu
Uvne yisrael vihuda hayyoshvim beare yehuda gam-hem masar bakar vatzon umasar kadashim hamkuddashim la-Adonai elohehem heviu vayyittenu aremot aremot
Bachodesh hashshelishi hechellu haaremot leyissod uvachodesh hashshevii killu
Vayyavou yechizkiyyahu vehassarim vayyiru et-haaremot vayevarachu et-Adonai veet ammo yisrael
Vayyidrosh yechizkiyyahu al-hakkohanim vehalviyyim al-haaremot
Vayyomer elav azaryahu hakkohen harosh levet tzadok vayyomer mehachel hatteruma lavi vet-Adonai achol vesavoa vehoter ad-larov ki Adonai berach et-ammo vehannotar et-hehamon hazze
Vayyomer yechizkiyyahu lehachin leshachot bevet Adonai vayyachinu
Vayyaviu et-hatteruma vehammaaser vehakkodashim beemuna vaalehem nagid kananyahu hallevi veshimi achihu mishne
Vichiel vaazazyahu venachat vaasahel virimot veozavad veeliel veyismachyahu umachat uvnayahu pekidim miyyad kananyahu veshimi achiv bemifkad yechizkiyyahu hammelech vaazaryahu negid bet-haelohim
Vekore ven-yimna hallevi hashshoer lammizracha al nidvot haelohim latet terumat Adonai vekadshe hakkodashim
Veal-yado eden uminyamin veyeshua ushmayahu amaryahu ushchanyahu beare hakkohanim beemuna latet laachehem bemachlekot kaggadol kakkatan
Millevad hityachsam lizcharim mibben shalosh shanim ulmala lechal-habba levet-Adonai lidvar-yom beomo laavodatam bemishmerotam kemachlekotehem
Veet hityaches hakkohanim levet avotehem vehalviyyim mibben esrim shana ulmala bemishmerotehem bemachlekotehem
Ulhityaches bechal-tappam neshehem uvnehem uvnotehem lechal-kahal ki veemunatam yitkaddeshu-kodesh
Velivne aharon hakkohanim bisde migrash arehem bechal-ir vair anashim asher nikkevu beshemot latet manot lechal-zachar bakkohanim ulchal-hityaches balviyyim
Vayyaas kazot yechizkiyyahu bechal-yehuda vayyaas hattov vehayyashar vehaemet lifne Adonai elohav
Uvchal-maase asher-hechel baavodat bet-haelohim uvattora uvammitzva lidrosh lelohav bechal-levavo asa vehitzliach
Achare haddevarim vehaemet haelle ba sancheriv melech-ashshur vayyavo vihuda vayyichan al-hearim habbetzurot vayyomer levikam elav
Vayyar yechizkiyyahu ki-va sancheriv ufanav lammilchama al-yerushalam
Vayyivaatz im-sarav vegibborav listom et-meme haayanot asher michutz lair vayyazeruhu
Vayyikkavtzu am-rav vayyistemu et-kal-hammayanot veet-hannachal hashshotef betoch-haaretz lemor lamma yavou malche ashshur umatzu mayim rabbim
Vayyitchazzak vayyiven et-kal-hachoma happerutza vayyaal al-hammigdalot velachutza hachoma acheret vayechazzek et-hammillo ir david vayyaas shelach larov umaginnim
Vayyitten sare milchamot al-haam vayyikbetzem elav el-rechov shaar hair vayedabber al-levavam lemor
Chizku veimtzu al-tiru veal-techattu mippene melech ashshur umillifne kal-hehamon asher-immo ki-immanu rav meimmo
Immo zeroa basar veimmanu Adonai elohenu leazrenu ulhillachem milchamotenu vayyissamchu haam al-divre yechizkiyyahu melech-yehuda
Achar ze shalach sancheriv melech-ashshur avadav yerushalayema vehu al-lachish vechal-memshalto immo al-yechizkiyyahu melech yehuda veal-kal-yehuda asher birushalam lemor
Ko amar sancheriv melech ashshur al-ma attem botchim veyoshvim bematzor birushalam
Halo yechizkiyyahu massit etchem latet etchem lamut beraav uvtzama lemor Adonai elohenu yatztzilenu mikkaf melech ashshur
Halo-hu yechizkiyyahu hesir et-bamotav veet-mizbechotav vayyomer lihuda velirushalam lemor lifne mizbeach echad tishtachau vealav taktiru
Halo tedu me asiti ani vaavotay lechol amme haaratzot hayachol yachlu elohe goye haaratzot lehatztzil et-artzam miyyadi
Mi bechal-elohe haggoyim haelle asher hecherimu avotay asher yachol lehatztzil et-ammo miyyadi ki yuchal elohechem lehatztzil etchem miyyadi

Veatta al-yashshi etchem chizkiyyahu veal-yassit etchem kazot veal-taaminu lo ki-lo yuchal kal-eloha kal-goy umamlacha lehatztzil ammo miyyadi umiyyad avotay af ki elohechem lo-yatztzilu etchem miyyadi
Veod dibberu avadav al-Adonai haelohim veal yechizkiyyahu avdo
Usfarim katav lecharef la-Adonai elohe yisrael velemor alav lemor kelohe goye haaratzot asher lo-hitztzilu ammam miyyadi ken lo-yatztzil elohe yechizkiyyahu ammo miyyadi
Vayyikreu vekol-gadol yehudit al-am yerushalam asher al-hachoma leyaram ulvahalam lemaan yilkedu et-hair
Vayedabberu el-elohe yerushalam keal elohe amme haaretz maase yede haadam
Vayyitpallel yechizkiyyahu hammelech vishayahu ven-amotz hannavi al-zot vayyizaku hashshamayim
Vayyishlach Adonai malach vayyachched kal-gibbor chayil venagid vesar bemachane melech ashshur vayyashav bevoshet panim leartzo vayyavo bet elohav umitzie meav sham hippiluhu vecharev
Vayyosha Adonai et-yechizkiyyahu veet yoshve yerushalam miyyad sancheriv melech-ashshur umiyyad-kol vayenahalem missaviv
Verabbim meviim mincha la-Adonai lirushalam umigdanot lichizkiyyahu melech yehuda vayyinnasse leene chal-haggoyim meachare-chen
Bayyamim hahem chala yechizkiyyahu ad-lamut vayyitpallel el-Adonai vayyomer lo umofet natan lo
Velo-chigmul alav heshiv yechizkiyyahu ki gavah libbo vayehi alav ketzef veal-yehuda virushalam
Vayyikkana yechizkiyyahu begovah libbo hu veyoshve yerushalam velo-va alehem ketzef Adonai bime yechizkiyyahu
Vayehi lichizkiyyahu osher vechavod harbe meod veotzarot asa-lo lechesef ulzahav uleven yekara velivsamim ulmaginnim ulchol kele chemda
Umiskenot litvuat dagan vetirosh veyitzhar veuraot lechal-behema uvhema vaadarim laaverot
Vearim asa lo umikne-tzon uvakar larov ki natan-lo elohim rechush rav meod
Vehu yechizkiyyahu satam et-motza meme gichon haelon vayyashrem lematta-marava leir david vayyatzlach yechizkiyyahu bechal-maasehu
Vechen bimlitze sare bavel hamshallechim alav lidrosh hammofet asher haya vaaretz azavo haelohim lenassoto ladaat kal-bilvavo
Veyeter divre yechizkiyyahu vachasadav hinnam ketuvim bachazon yeshayahu ven-amotz hannavi al-sefer malche-yehuda veyisrael
Vayyishkav yechizkiyyahu im-avotav vayyikberuhu bemaale kivre vene-david vechavod asu-lo vemoto kal-yehuda veyoshve yerushalam vayyimloch menashshe veno tachtav
Ben-shettem esre shana menashshe vemalcho vachamishshim vechamesh shana malach birushalam
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai ketoavot haggoyim asher horish Adonai mippene bene yisrael
Vayyashav vayyiven et-habbamot asher nittatz yechizkiyyahu aviv vayyakem mizbechot labbealim vayyaas asherot vayyishtachu lechal-tzeva hashshamayim vayyaavod otam
Uvana mizbechot bevet Adonai asher amar Adonai birushalam yihye-shemi leolam
Vayyiven mizbechot lechal-tzeva hashshamayim bishte chatzrot bet-Adonai
Vehu heevir et-banav baesh bege ven-hinnom veonen venichesh vechishshef veasa ov veyiddeoni hirba laasot hara beene Adonai lehachiso
Vayyasem et-pesel hassemel asher asa bevet haelohim asher amar elohim el-david veel-shelomo veno babbayit hazze uvirushalam asher bacharti mikkol shivte yisrael asim et-shemi leelom
Velo osif lehasir et-regel yisrael meal haadama asher heemadti laavotechem rak im-yishmeru laasot et kal-asher tzivitim lechal-hattora vehachukkim vehammishpatim beyad-moshe
Vayyeta menashshe et-yehuda veyoshve yerushalam laasot ra min-haggoyim asher hishmid Adonai mippene bene yisrael
Vayedabber Adonai el-menashshe veel-ammo velo hikshivu
Vayyave Adonai alehem et-sare hatztzava asher lemelech ashshur vayyilkedu et-menashshe bachochim vayyaasruhu banchushtayim vayyolichuhu bavela
Uchhatzer lo chilla et-pene Adonai elohav vayyikkana meod millifne elohe avotav
Vayyitpallel elav vayyeater lo vayyishma techinnato vayeshivehu yerushalam lemalchuto vayyeda menashshe ki Adonai hu haelohim
Veachare-chen bana choma chitzona leir-david marava legichon bannachal velavo veshaar haddagim vesavav laofel vayyagbiheha meod vayyasem sare-chayil bechal-hearim habbetzurot bihuda
Vayyasar et-elohe hannechar veet-hassemel mibbet Adonai vechal-hammizbechot asher bana behar bet-Adonai uvirushalam vayyashlech chutza lair
Vayyiven et-mizbach Adonai vayyizbach alav zivche shelamim vetoda vayyomer lihuda laavod et-Adonai elohe yisrael
Aval od haam zovchim babbamot rak la-Adonai elohehem
Veyeter divre menashshe utfillato el-elohav vedivre hachozim hamdabberim elav beshem Adonai elohe yisrael hinnam al-divre malche yisrael
Utfillato veheater-lo vechal-chattato umalo vehammekomot asher bana vahem bamot veheemid haasherim vehappesilim lifne hikkano hinnam ketuvim al divre chozay
Vayyishkav menashshe im-avotav vayyikberuhu beto vayyimloch amon beno tachtav
Ben-esrim ushtayim shana amon bemalcho ushtayim shanim malach birushalam
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai kaasher asa menashshe aviv ulchal-happesilim asher asa menashshe aviv zibbach amon vayyaavdem
Velo nichna millifne Adonai kehikkana menashshe aviv ki hu amon hirba ashma
Vayyiksheru alav avadav vayemituhu beveto
Vayyakku am-haaretz et kal-hakkoshrim al-hammelech amon vayyamlichu am-haaretz et-yoshiyyahu veno tachtav
Ben-shemone shanim yoshiyyahu vemalcho ushloshim veachat shana malach birushalam
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai vayyelech bedarche david aviv velo-sar yamin usmol
Uvishmone shanim lemalcho vehu odennu naar hechel lidrosh lelohe david aviv uvishtem esre shana hechel letaher et-yehuda virushalam min-habbamot vehaasherim vehappesilim vehammassechot
Vayenattetzu lefanav et mizbechot habbealim vehachammanim asher-lemala mealehem giddea vehaasherim vehappesilim vehammassechot shibbar vehedak vayyizrok al-pene hakkevarim hazzovchim lahem
Veatzmot kohanim saraf mizbechotam vayetaher et-yehuda veet-yerushalam
Uvare menashshe veefrayim veshimon vead-naftali vhr becharvotehem saviv
Vayenattetz et-hammizbechot veet-haasherim vehappesilim kittat lehedak vechal-hachammanim gidda bechal-eretz yisrael vayyashav lirushalam
Uvishnat shemone esre lemalcho letaher haaretz vehabbayit shalach et-shafan ben-atzalyahu veet-maaseyahu sar-hair veet yoach ben-yoachaz hammazkir lechazzek et-bet Adonai elohav

Vayyavou el-chilkiyyahu hakkohen haggadol vayyittenu et-hakkesef hammuva vet-elohim asher asfu-halviyyim shomre hassaf miyyad menashshe veefrayim umikkol sheerit yisrael umikkal-yehuda uvinyamin vayyashuvu yerushalam
Vayyittenu al-yad ose hammelacha hammufkadim bevet Adonai vayyittenu oto ose hammelacha asher osim bevet Adonai livdok ulchazzek habbayit
Vayyittenu lecharashim velabbonim liknot avne machtzev veetzim lamchabberot ulkarot et-habbattim asher hishchitu malche yehuda
Vehaanashim osim beemuna bammelacha vaalehem mufkadim yachat veovadyahu halviyyim min-bene merari uzcharya umshullam min-bene hakkehatim lenatztzeach vehalviyyim kal-mevin bichle-shir
Veal hassabbalim umnatztzechim lechol ose melacha laavoda vaavoda umehalviyyim sofrim veshotrim veshoarim
Uvhotziam et-hakkesef hammuva bet Adonai matza chilkiyyahu hakkohen et-sefer torat-Adonai beyad-moshe
Vayyaan chilkiyyahu vayyomer el-shafan hassofer sefer hattora matzati bevet Adonai vayyitten chilkiyyahu et-hassefer el-shafan
Vayyave shafan et-hassefer el-hammelech vayyashev od et-hammelech davar lemor kol asher-nittan beyad-avadecha hem osim
Vayyattichu et-hakkesef hannimtza bevet-Adonai vayyittenuhu al-yad hammufkadim veal-yad ose hammelacha
Vayyagged shafan hassofer lammelech lemor sefer natan li chilkiyyahu hakkohen vayyikra-vo shafan lifne hammelech
Vayehi kishmoa hammelech et divre hattora vayyikra et-begadav
Vayetzav hammelech et-chilkiyyahu veet-achikam ben-shafan veet-avdon ben-micha veet shafan hassofer veet asaya eved-hammelech lemor

Lechu dirshu et-Adonai baadi uvad hannishar beyisrael uvihuda al-divre hassefer asher nimtza ki-gedola chamat-Adonai asher nittecha vanu al asher lo-shamru avotenu et-devar Adonai laasot kechal-hakkatuv al-hassefer hazze
Vayyelech chilkiyyahu vaasher hammelech el-chulda hannevia eshet shallum takhat ben-chasra shomer habbegadim vehi yoshevet birushalam bammishne vayedabberu eleha kazot
Vattomer lahem ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael imru laish asher-shalach etchem elay
Ko amar Adonai hinni mevi raa al-hammakom hazze veal-yoshvav et kal-haalot hakketuvot al-hassefer asher karu lifne melech yehuda
Tachat asher azavuni vayekatteru lelohim acherim lemaan hachiseni bechol maase yedehem vetittach chamati bammakom hazze velo tichbe
Veel-melech yehuda hashsholeach etchem lidrosh ba-Adonai ko tomru elav s ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael haddevarim asher shamata
Yaan rach-levavcha vattikkana millifne elohim beshamacha et-devarav al-hammakom hazze veal-yoshvav vattikkana lefanay vattikra et-begadecha vattevke lefanay vegam-ani shamati neum-Adonai
Hinni osifcha el-avotecha veneesafta el-kivrotecha beshalom velo-tirena enecha bechol haraa asher ani mevi al-hammakom hazze veal-yoshvav vayyashivu et-hammelech davar
Vayyishlach hammelech vayyeesof et-kal-zikne yehuda virushalam
Vayyaal hammelech bet-Adonai vechal-ish yehuda veyoshve yerushalam vehakkohanim vehalviyyim vechal-haam miggadol vead-katan vayyikra veaznehem et-kal-divre sefer habberit hannimtza bet Adonai

Vayyaamod hammelech al-amdo vayyichrot et-habberit lifne Adonai lalechet achare Adonai velishmor et-mitzotav veedotav vechukkav bechal-levavo uvchal-nafsho laasot et-divre habberit hakketuvim al-hassefer hazze
Vayyaamed et kal-hannimtza virushalam uvinyamin vayyaasu yoshve yerushalam kivrit elohim elohe avotehem
Vayyasar yoshiyyahu et-kal-hattoevot mikkal-haaratzot asher livne yisrael vayyaaved et kal-hannimtza beyisrael laavod et-Adonai elohehem kal-yamav lo saru meachare Adonai elohe avotehem
Vayyaas yoshiyyahu virushalam pesach la-Adonai vayyishchatu happesach bearbaa asar lachodesh harishon
Vayyaamed hakkohanim al-mishmerotam vayechazzekem laavodat bet Adonai

Vayyomer lalviyyim hammevinim lechal-yisrael hakkedoshim la-Adonai tenu et-aron-hakkodesh babbayit asher bana shelomo ven-david melech yisrael en-lachem massa bakkatef atta ivdu et-Adonai elohechem veet ammo yisrael
Vehachinu levet-avotechem kemachlekotechem bichtav david melech yisrael uvmichtav shelomo veno
Veimdu vakkodesh lifluggot bet haavot laachechem bene haam vachalukkat bet-av lalviyyim
Veshachatu happasach vehitkaddeshu vehachinu laachechem laasot kidvar-Adonai beyad-moshe
Vayyarem yoshiyyahu livne haam tzon kevasim uvne-izzim hakkol lappesachim lechal-hannimtza lemispar sheloshim elef uvakar sheloshet alafim elle merchush hammelech
Vesarav lindava laam lakkohanim velalviyyim herimu chilkiyya uzcharyahu vichiel negide bet haelohim lakkohanim natnu lappesachim alpayim veshesh meot uvakar shelosh meot
Vechananyahu ushmayahu untanel echav vachashavyahu viiel veozavad sare halviyyim herimu lalviyyim lappesachim chameshet alafim uvakar chamesh meot
Vattikkon haavoda vayyaamdu hakkohanim al-amdam vehalviyyim al-machlekotam kemitzvat hammelech
Vayyishchatu happasach vayyizreku hakkohanim miyyadam vehalviyyim mafshitim
Vayyasiru haola letittam lemiflaggot levet-avot livne haam lehakriv la-Adonai kakkatuv besefer moshe vechen labbakar
Vayevashshelu happesach baesh kammishpat vehakkodashim bishshelu bassirot uvaddevadim uvatztzelachot vayyaritzu lechal-bene haam
Veachar hechinu lahem velakkohanim ki hakkohanim bene aharon behaalot haola vehachalavim ad-layela vehalviyyim hechinu lahem velakkohanim bene aharon
Vehamshorarim bene-asaf al-maamadam kemitzvat david veasaf veheman vidutun choze hammelech vehashshoarim leshaar vashaar en lahem lasur meal avodatam ki-achehem halviyyim hechinu lahem
Vattikkon kal-avodat Adonai bayyom hahu laasot happesach vehaalot olot al mizbach Adonai kemitzvat hammelech yoshiyyahu
Vayyaasu vene-yisrael hannimtzeim et-happesach baet hahi veet-chag hammatztzot shivat yamim
Velo-naasa fesach kamohu beyisrael mime shemuel hannavi vechal-malche yisrael lo-asu kappesach asher-asa yoshiyyahu vehakkohanim vehalviyyim vechal-yehuda veyisrael hannimtza veoshve yerushalam
Bishmone esre shana lemalchut yoshiyyahu naasa happesach hazze
Achare chal-zot asher hechin yoshiyyahu et-habbayit ala necho melech-mitzrayim lehillachem becharkemish al-perat vayyetze likrato yoshiyyahu
Vayyishlach elav malachim lemor ma-li valach melech yehuda lo-alecha atta hayyom ki el-bet milchamti velohim amar levahaleni chadal-lecha meelohim asher-immi veal-yashchitecha
Velo-hesev yoshiyyahu fanav mimmennu ki lehillachem-bo hitchappes velo shama el-divre necho mippi elohim vayyavo lehillachem bevikat megiddo
Vayyoru hayyorim lammelech yoshiyyahu vayyomer hammelech laavadav haaviruni ki hacholeti meod
Vayyaaviruhu avadav min-hammerkava vayyarkivuhu al rechev hammishne asher-lo vayyolichuhu yerushalam vayyamat vayyikkaver bekivrot avotav vechal-yehuda virushalam mitabbelim al-yoshiyyahu
Vayekonen yirmeyahu al-yoshiyyahu vayyomru chal-hashsharim vehashsharot bekinotehem al-yoshiyyahu ad-hayyom vayyittenum lechok al-yisrael vehinnam ketuvim al-hakkinot
Veyeter divre yoshiyyahu vachasadav kakkatuv betorat Adonai
Udvarav harishonim vehaacharonim hinnam ketuvim al-sefer malche-yisrael vihuda
Vayyikchu am-haaretz et-yehoachaz ben-yoshiyyahu vayyamlichuhu tachat-aviv birushalam
Ben-shalosh veesrim shana yoachaz bemalcho ushlosha chodashim malach birushalam
Vayesirehu melech-mitzrayim birushalam vayyaanosh et-haaretz mea chikkar-kesef vechikkar zahav
Vayyamlech melech-mitzrayim et-elyakim achiv al-yehuda virushalam vayyassev et-shemo yehoyakim veet-yoachaz achiv lakach necho vayeviehu mitzrayema
Ben-esrim vechamesh shana yehoyakim bemalcho veachat esre shana malach birushalam vayyaas hara beene Adonai elohav
Alav ala nevuchadnetzar melech bavel vayyaasrehu banchushtayim leholicho bavela
Umikkele bet Adonai hevi nevuchadnetzar levavel vayyittenem behechalo bevavel
Veyeter divre yehoyakim vetoavotav asher-asa vehannimtza alav hinnam ketuvim al-sefer malche yisrael vihuda vayyimloch yehoyachin beno tachtav
Ben-shemone shanim yehoyachin bemalcho ushlosha chodashim vaaseret yamim malach birushalam vayyaas hara beene Adonai
Velitshuvat hashshana shalach hammelech nevuchadnetzar vayeviehu vavela im-kele chemdat bet-Adonai vayyamlech et-tzidkiyyahu achiv al-yehuda virushalam
Ben-esrim veachat shana tzidkiyyahu vemalcho veachat esre shana malach birushalam
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai elohav lo nichna millifne yirmeyahu hannavi mippi Adonai
Vegam bammelech nevuchadnetzar marad asher hishbio belohim vayyekesh et-arpo vayeammetz et-levavo mishshuv el-Adonai elohe yisrael
Gam kal-sare hakkohanim vehaam hirbu limal-maal kechol toavot haggoyim vayetammeu et-bet Adonai asher hikdish birushalam
Vayyishlach Adonai elohe avotehem alehem beyad malachav hashkem veshaloach ki-chamal al-ammo veal-meono
Vayyihu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav ad alot chamat-Adonai beammo ad-leen marpe
Vayyaal alehem et-melech kasdim vayyaharog bachurehem bacherev bevet mikdasham velo chamal al-bachur uvtula zaken veyashesh hakkol natan beyado
Vechol kele bet haelohim haggedolim vehakketannim veotzrot bet Adonai veotzrot hammelech vesarav hakkol hevi vavel
Vayyisrefu et-bet haelohim vayenattetzu et chomat yerushalam vechal-armenoteha sarfu vaesh vechal-kele machamaddeha lehashchit
Vayyegel hashsheerit min-hacherev el-bavel vayyihu-lo ulvanav laavadim ad-meloch malchut paras
Lemallot devar-Adonai befi yirmeyahu ad-ratzta haaretz et-shabbetoteha kal-yeme hashshamma shavata lemallot shivim shana
Uvishnat achat lechoresh melech paras lichlot devar-Adonai befi yirmeyahu heir Adonai et-ruach koresh melech-paras vayyaaver-kol bechal-malchuto vegam-bemichtav lemor
Ko-amar koresh melech paras kal-mamlechot haaretz natan li Adonai elohe hashshamayim vehu-fakad alay livnot-lo vayit birushalam asher bihuda mi-vachem mikkal-ammo Adonai elohav immo veyaal
